title: Government Sales Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 SCS Tech India Pvt Ltd is a technology and digital transformation company that helps organizations address complex business challenges through consulting and tailored technology solutions. The company’s services span software development, AI/ML and data analytics, cloud, cybersecurity, automation, GIS, and other emerging technologies. SCS Tech India partners closely with clients from strategy through implementation to simplify complexity and deliver measurable business outcomes. With experience across sectors such as energy, BFSI, healthcare, telecom, transportation, infrastructure, defense, and urban development, the team combines deep technology expertise with strong industry insight. Guided by the belief that the right technology, applied with clear vision, can create lasting change, SCS Tech India is focused on leading the pathway of digital transformation.
 



**Role Description** 
 Sales Manager – IT Government Sales will be responsible for driving business growth by managing government accounts, building strong client relationships, and achieving sales targets. This role requires expertise in government procurement processes, tender management, and solution selling within the IT domain. The Information Technology Sales Manager role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Mumbai. This role involves driving IT solutions sales by identifying new business opportunities, generating qualified leads, and managing the end\-to\-end sales cycle. The Information Technology Sales Manager will build and maintain relationships with key accounts, understand client requirements, and collaborate with technical teams to propose suitable solutions and prepare tailored presentations and proposals. Daily responsibilities include pipeline management, forecasting, negotiating contracts, and ensuring customer satisfaction post\-sale. The role also requires monitoring market trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to refine sales strategies and support growth targets.
 



**Qualifications** 




  




* Candidates should possess strong Government IT Sales and Sales skills, with experience in consultative selling of technology solutions.
* shoud have experience with State Government, Central Government, PSU’s.
* Candidates should possess Lead Generation skills, including prospecting, qualifying opportunities, and managing a robust sales pipeline.
* Candidates should possess Account Management skills, with the ability to nurture client relationships and drive repeat and upsell business.
* Candidates should possess a solid understanding of Information Technology domains relevant to digital transformation, such as software, cloud, data, and cybersecurity.
* Relevant skills and qualifications include excellent communication and negotiation abilities, strong business acumen, and proficiency with CRM tools and sales reporting.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, information technology, or a related field is preferred, along with prior experience in B2B IT or tech services sales.
* Ability to work collaboratively with technical and delivery teams, meet targets under deadlines, and adapt to a fast\-changing technology landscape.

title: Institutional Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Namya Press is a modern, digital\-first platform that enables authors, publishers, and institutions to create, manage, and distribute books globally with ease. The company focuses on self\-service tools, print\-on\-demand, and worldwide book distribution, giving users complete creative control over their publishing journey. By streamlining content and cover design, royalty tracking, and distribution, Namya Press reduces the delays and complexities of traditional publishing. The platform serves aspiring writers, academic professionals, and small publishing houses, offering a one\-stop solution for end\-to\-end book publishing and management.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Institutional Sales Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Dwarka. This role is responsible for identifying and building relationships with educational institutions, libraries, universities, and other organizations to drive adoption of Namya Press’s publishing and distribution solutions. Day\-to\-day activities include prospecting and pitching to institutional clients, developing sales strategies, preparing proposals, and negotiating contracts. The Institutional Sales Manager will collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding, address client needs, and provide ongoing account management. The role also involves tracking sales performance, forecasting revenue, and maintaining accurate records in CRM tools.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Institutional Sales and Sales skills, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
* Candidates should possess Finance and Investments knowledge to understand institutional budgeting and purchasing decisions.
* Candidates should possess excellent Customer Service skills to manage relationships, resolve issues, and support long\-term client engagement.
* Candidates should possess strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills to effectively engage institutional stakeholders.
* Relevant experience in publishing, EdTech, or selling to educational and academic institutions is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to work on\-site in Dwarka, manage multiple accounts, and use CRM and sales reporting tools effectively.

description:
ATRASKI EVENTS:
 





 Business Development – Job Description
 




  






 POSITION OVERVIEW
 





 Position Title: Business Development Executive – Events
 





 Department: Atraski Events (Business Development)
 





 Reports To: Head of Business Development – Events
 





 Location: Delhi (Chittaranjan Park / Greater Kailash)
 





 Timings: Monday to Friday and Alternate Saturday
 




  






 About Atraski Events:
 





 Atraski Events is a full\-service experiential marketing and event management division of Atraski, a strategic marketing agency. We design and execute high\-impact corporate events, conferences, product launches, brand activations, and experiential campaigns for marquee clients across technology, FMCG, real estate, finance, and luxury sectors. Our focus is on delivering measurable ROI through strategic storytelling and immersive brand experiences.
 




  






 ROLE PURPOSE:
 





 The Business Development Executive will be responsible for identifying, qualifying, and closing new event and experiential marketing opportunities in the corporate events, conferences, brand activations, and experiential marketing space. This is a hunter role focused on pipeline generation, prospect management, and deal closure in the events vertical.
 




  






 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 





 Lead Generation \& Pipeline Development
 



1. Identify and qualify corporate event opportunities, conferences, product launches, and brand activation projects through direct outreach, industry research, and networking
2. Build and maintain a robust pipeline of 40–60 qualified leads at various stages of the sales cycle
3. Conduct market research to identify emerging event categories, corporate restructuring signals, and industry trends
4. Target companies across technology, FMCG, finance, real estate, luxury, pharma, and EdTech sectors with budgets ₹10L–₹1Cr\+



  






 Prospect Engagement \& Relationship Building
 



1. Conduct discovery calls with CMOs, EVPs–Marketing, Event Directors, and procurement stakeholders
2. Present Atraski Events' capabilities through tailored deck presentations and case studies
3. Build executive relationships across client organization (Marketing, HR, Operations, Procurement)
4. Maintain CRM discipline and update deal status, contact notes, and next steps in real\-time



  






 Proposal \& Deal Closure
 



1. Develop tailored event briefs, scope\-of\-work (SOW) documents, and pricing proposals
2. Collaborate with internal delivery, creative, and operations teams to build client\-ready proposals
3. Manage objection\-handling and negotiation cycles through closure
4. Meet quarterly revenue targets (target: ₹2\.5–3Cr annual pipeline contribution)
5. Account Transition \& Stakeholder Alignment
6. Hand off closed deals to Account POC or Vendor with clear delivery briefs and client context
7. Maintain involvement in kickoff meetings to ensure smooth project initiation
8. upport post\-event upsell opportunities and contract renewals



  






 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
 





 Experience:
 



1. 3–5 years of B2B sales or business development experience (events, experiential marketing, or agency preferred)
2. Proven track record of closing deals in the ₹15L–₹80L range (event budgets and contracts)
3. Experience managing 40\+ prospect relationships simultaneously with a disciplined pipeline approach
4. Understanding of corporate event ecosystem (conferences, annual meetings, product launches, brand activations)



  






 Education \& Credentials
 



1. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field (MBA preferred but not required)
2. Fluency in English and Hindi (conversational and professional)



  






 Technical \& Tool Proficiency:
 



1. Proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce, Zoho, or equivalent) and sales methodologies (SPIN, MEDDIC, or similar)
2. Advanced MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills
3. Comfortable with virtual meetings, screen sharing, and remote collaboration tools



  






 CORE COMPETENCIES
 



1. Sales Excellence: Ability to qualify leads, navigate complex decision\-making units, and close deals
2. Resilience \& Persistence: Comfort with rejection; ability to maintain momentum through a long sales cycle
3. Executive Presence: Ability to communicate with C\-suite and stakeholders with confidence and credibility
4. Consultative Approach: Focus on understanding client needs before pitching solutions
5. Organizational Skills: CRM discipline, follow\-up rigor, and ability to manage multiple concurrent negotiations
6. Problem\-Solving: Ability to customize proposals and handle objections creatively
7. Teamwork: Strong collaboration with internal teams to deliver client promises



  






 Benefits:
 





 • 12 PTO days \+ public holidays
 





 • Flexible work arrangement (office\-based with remote flexibility for client meetings)
 





 • Access to Atraski's full suite of tools (CRM, design, analytics, brand resources)
 




  






 WORK ENVIRONMENT \& CULTURE
 





 • Fast\-paced, founder\-driven agency environment with direct visibility to leadership
 





 • Collaborative cross\-functional teams (creative, production, accounts, operations)
 





 • Access to high\-profile clients and marquee event projects
 





 • Focus on results, ownership, and impact over process
 





 • Regular team engagement and professional development opportunities
 




  






 HOW TO APPLY
 





 Interested candidates should submit:
 





 • Detailed resume highlighting sales achievements and deal closure metrics
 





 • Cover letter describing your interest in events/experiential marketing
 





 • 2–3 references from previous employers/clients
 




  






 Email: anish.dhar@atraski.com and hr@atraski.com
 





 Subject: BD – Events Application \| \[Your Name]
 





 Atraski is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment.

 LA People is building the manufacturing partner that fashion founders actually need — an end to end studio that takes an idea from a single reference sketch all the way to a finished, dispatched garment, without the minimum order requirements that shut most first\-time founders out.

 • Respond to inbound leads from Instagram, WhatsApp, and Google ads

title: Senior Solutions Lead (Pre-Sales & Implementation)
description:
**About This Job**
**Knowmax**
**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Technology, Information and Internet
   

  

**Job Description**
 Knowmax is an AI Knowledge Management platform built for enterprise CX teams. Telecom, BFSI, healthcare and BPO leaders use us to turn scattered process documentation into guided, AI\-ready answers their agents and customers can act on, across every channel.
   

  

 Governed knowledge that drives action. That is the whole idea.
   

  

 We are part of the KocharTech group, and we serve enterprise customers across North America, the GCC, Southeast Asia and APAC. The US is our biggest growth bet right now, and this role sits close to it.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 You win the deal, then you deliver it.
   

  

 Most companies split this into two jobs and lose something in the handover. The promise made in the demo quietly becomes someone else's problem at kickoff. We keep it in one pair of hands. You shape the technical solution during the sales cycle, then own the implementation once the contract is signed.
   

  

 Roughly half your time is pre\-sales: discovery, demos, proofs of concept, RFPs. The other half is implementation: configuration, integrations, go\-live, early adoption. In practice the split flexes week to week with whatever is closing or going live.
   

  

 You will be the technical face of Knowmax to enterprise buyers and the steady hand that gets them live. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership individual contributor seat, not a people management track.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 Pre\-sales
   

  

 Run technical discovery. Map the prospect's contact centre stack, content estate and integration surface before anyone promises anythingBuild and deliver tailored demos and proofs of concept against the buyer's actual use cases, not a generic scriptOwn the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs and security questionnairesWork alongside sales as the trusted technical advisor through the deal cycleTranslate requirements into clear solution designs, scopes of work and timelines we can actually holdCall out the deals we should not chase. A clean no early is worth more to us than a messy yes.
   

  

 Implementation
   

  

 Own enterprise implementations end to end, from kickoff to go\-liveConfigure the platform, run integrations across CRM, CCaaS, ticketing, SSO and APIs, and oversee content migrationRun onboarding and enablement so customer teams genuinely adopt what we build, not just receive itCoordinate across customer success, engineering and product to clear blockersBuild the implementation playbooks, templates and documentation that make the next ten deployments faster than the last
   

  

**What The First Six Months Look Like**
 Month 1: fluent in the product. Shadowing live deals and one active implementationMonth 3: running discovery and demos independently, and owning at least one enterprise implementation through to go\-liveMonth 6: the default technical voice on our largest pursuits, with a documented implementation playbook a new joiner can follow
   

  

**What You Bring**
 Must have
   

  

 6 to 10 years in solutions engineering, technical pre\-sales, implementation or customer\-facing technical delivery, ideally in enterprise SaaSWorking command of enterprise integrations: REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and SAML, and the common CX stack (Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Genesys, Amazon Connect, Cisco, Freshworks, Microsoft Dynamics)Enough fluency in how modern AI knowledge systems work to lead a credible discovery conversation: retrieval quality, grounding answers in source content, handling accuracy and hallucination concerns, and what it takes to get a customer's content AI\-readyPresence with both technical evaluators and business sponsors, often in the same roomHands\-on configuration ability. You are comfortable in the detail of a deployment, not just the diagram of oneExperience carrying enterprise security and compliance conversations: SOC 2, data residency, access controlWriting that holds up. Solution documents, scopes and responses a CIO will actually readEngineering background is a must
   

  

 Nice to have
   

  

 Contact centre or CX domain backgroundExposure to US, GCC or Southeast Asia enterprise buyersMultilingual or Arabic deployment experienceTime at a company scaling from early traction to repeatable enterprise delivery
   

  

 THE PRACTICAL STUFF
   

  

 Based in Gurgaon, WFOOur customers sit in North America, EMEA and APAC, so part of your day shifts earlier or later to meet them. That is a flexed schedule, not extra hours stacked on top of a full office dayOccasional travel for key customer engagements. Frequency depends on the accounts you support
   

  

 WHY THIS SEAT
   

  

 You report to the CTO and work close to the leadership team. You will see a deal from first call to first value, which is rare in enterprise software and hard to learn any other way. The playbooks and documentation you build become how the company sells and delivers as we scale in the US and the GCC.
   

  

 If you like both selling the vision and making it real, this is the seat.

 Engage decision\-makers at target accounts through personalised outreach and calls. Build interest, turn cold prospects into warm leads, schedule qualified meetings and hand over opportunities to the sales team with clear context and next steps.

 Understand the prospect’s business, revenue, advertising spends, current agency setup, growth objectives and challenges. Identify decision\-makers, buying intent and timelines.

 Keep contact details, conversation notes, lead stages, follow\-up dates and next steps accurate and updated.

 Build a structured follow\-up process, re\-engage dormant leads and maintain relationships with prospects who are not ready to buy immediately.
* **Objection handling:** 
 Address initial questions on services, fit and commercials, bringing in the relevant team when deeper expertise is needed.

 Share feedback on lead quality, common objections and reasons for drop\-offs to improve campaigns and conversion.

 Track pipeline movement and flag stalled opportunities or support needed to progress them.

* 3–4 years of experience in sales, pre\-sales or business development, preferably in a B2B agency, SaaS or digital marketing business.

* Strong spoken and written communication, with confidence engaging founders, marketing heads and other senior stakeholders.

* Commercial awareness and the judgment to prioritise opportunities based on fit and intent.
* Strong ownership: you take initiative, follow through on commitments and flag blockers early.
* Willingness to travel for client pitches and meetings.



**How success will be measured** 



* Speed and quality of lead engagement.
* Target accounts engaged and cold prospects converted into qualified opportunities.
* Qualified meetings booked and attended.
* Lead\-to\-meeting and meeting\-to\-opportunity conversion.
* Follow\-up discipline and CRM accuracy.
* Contribution to qualified pipeline and converted to customers

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About AiSensy** 




  





 AiSensy is a
 **WhatsApp Engagement \& Marketing platform** 
 helping businesses acquire, engage, sell, and support customers on WhatsApp.
 



  





 We work with leading brands including
 **Adani, Delhi Transport Corporation, Yakult, Godrej, Aditya Birla Hindalco, Wipro, Asian Paints, India Today Group, Skullcandy, Vivo, PhysicsWallah and Cosco** 
 , along with thousands of SMBs and growing businesses.
 



 Today,
 **250,000\+ businesses** 
 use AiSensy to power their WhatsApp engagement and marketing.
 



  





 We're building products across
 **WhatsApp Marketing, Click\-to\-WhatsApp Ads, AI Agents, conversational commerce, automation and payments** 
 .
 



  





 As AiSensy continues to scale, we're looking for a
 **Key Account Manager – Enterprise Accounts** 
 to own relationships with some of our most important customers and help them get significantly more value from AiSensy.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 This isn't a typical account management role where you simply check in with customers and resolve issues.
 



  





**You will own the relationship, growth, adoption, and revenue of strategic enterprise accounts.** 




  





 You'll become the primary point of contact for key customers, understand their business goals, identify opportunities to expand their use of AiSensy, and work with internal teams to make sure they succeed.
 



  





 Your goal is to move customers from:
 



**Customer → Active Customer → Growing Customer → Strategic AiSensy Account** 




  





 You'll work closely with
 **Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, Marketing, Partnerships, and Leadership** 
 to drive customer outcomes.
 



  





 We want someone who can build strong executive relationships, understand business problems, spot expansion opportunities, and
 **take ownership until things get done.** 




  





**What You'll Own** 




**1\. Enterprise Account Ownership** 



* Own a portfolio of strategic and enterprise customers.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Understand each customer's business model, objectives, challenges, and WhatsApp strategy.
* Establish regular account review and engagement cadences.
* Build strong relationships across multiple stakeholders within each account.
* Ensure customers receive a high\-quality AiSensy experience.
* Maintain a clear understanding of account health, risks, opportunities, and next steps.



  





**2\. Account Growth \& Revenue Expansion** 




 Your responsibility doesn't end once the customer is onboarded.
 



**You will actively identify opportunities to grow the account.** 



* Identify expansion opportunities within existing enterprise accounts.
* Drive upsell and cross\-sell opportunities across AiSensy's products.
* Identify opportunities around:
* WhatsApp Marketing
* Click\-to\-WhatsApp Ads
* AI Agents
* Automation
* Conversational Commerce
* Payments
* Expand AiSensy's presence across business units, teams, products, and use cases.
* Build account\-specific growth plans.
* Work with Sales and Product teams to convert opportunities into revenue.
* Maintain a healthy expansion pipeline across assigned accounts.
* Track account revenue, usage, adoption, and expansion potential.



  





**3\. Strategic Account Planning** 




 Build a clear growth plan for every strategic account.
 



 For each customer, understand:
 



**Where are they today?** 




**What are they using AiSensy for?** 




**What are they not using yet?** 




**What business problem can we solve next?** 




**Who are the decision\-makers?** 




**What can the account become?** 



* Create account plans for key customers.
* Map stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Understand customer business priorities and upcoming initiatives.
* Identify whitespace opportunities across products and teams.
* Build quarterly and annual account growth plans.
* Track progress against account\-level objectives.
* Present account plans and growth opportunities internally.



  





**4\. Customer Engagement \& Executive Relationships** 




 Build relationships beyond the day\-to\-day user.
 


* Conduct regular business reviews with enterprise customers.
* Engage senior stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Present AiSensy solutions based on business objectives.
* Share product updates, industry insights, and relevant use cases.
* Identify opportunities to bring AiSensy leadership into strategic conversations.
* Build relationships that support long\-term retention and expansion.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally.



 The goal is to become a
 **trusted business partner** 
 , not just another vendor contact.
 



  





**5\. Product Adoption \& Customer Success** 




 Help customers get more value from AiSensy.
 


* Monitor product adoption and account usage.
* Identify underutilized products and features.
* Educate customers on new AiSensy capabilities.
* Work with Customer Success and Product teams to improve adoption.
* Identify accounts showing declining engagement or usage.
* Build action plans for at\-risk accounts.
* Ensure customer issues are followed through to resolution.
* Collect customer feedback and communicate meaningful insights to Product and Leadership.



  





**6\. Customer Growth Programs** 




 Develop structured programs to increase engagement and business outcomes across enterprise accounts.
 


* Create account\-specific growth and adoption plans.
* Identify high\-impact WhatsApp use cases.
* Share best practices and successful customer use cases.
* Help customers improve their WhatsApp marketing and engagement strategy.
* Drive adoption of new AiSensy products and capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to replicate successful use cases across different teams or business units.



  





**7\. Cross\-Functional Execution** 




 Enterprise accounts require strong internal coordination.
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Sales
* Customer Success
* Product
* Customer Support
* Marketing
* Partnerships
* Engineering
* Leadership



 to ensure smooth execution across strategic accounts.
 



 You will coordinate internal teams, manage expectations, remove blockers, and ensure commitments made to customers are followed through.
 



**You own the outcome—even when multiple teams are involved.** 




  





**8\. Retention \& Account Health** 




 Own the overall health of your accounts.
 



 Monitor:
 


* Product usage
* Customer engagement
* Revenue
* Expansion
* Renewal
* Support issues
* Customer satisfaction
* Stakeholder relationships



 Identify churn risks early.
 



 Build account recovery plans where required.
 



 Work proactively rather than waiting for the customer to raise a problem.
 



  





**9\. Customer Advocacy \& Strategic Relationships** 




 Turn successful customers into long\-term AiSensy advocates.
 


* Identify customers with strong business outcomes.
* Build opportunities for:
* Case studies
* Customer testimonials
* Customer stories
* Webinars
* Events
* References
* Brand Showcase
* Work with Marketing to showcase customer success.
* Build relationships that create opportunities for referrals and introductions.



  





**10\. Reporting \& Account Intelligence** 




 Maintain strong visibility into your account portfolio.
 



 Track:
 


* Account revenue
* Expansion revenue
* Product adoption
* Usage
* Renewal status
* Account health
* Pipeline
* Upsell opportunities
* Customer risks
* Key stakeholder relationships



 Maintain accurate CRM records and account plans.
 



 Provide regular updates on:
 



**What's growing?** 




**What's at risk?** 




**What's the opportunity?** 




**What needs leadership attention?** 




  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**Must Have** 



* **4–7 years of experience** 
 in Key Account Management, Enterprise Account Management, Customer Success, Account Growth, or Business Development.
* Proven experience managing and growing
 **existing enterprise/B2B accounts** 
 .
* Experience owning a portfolio of strategic customers.
* Track record of driving
 **upsell, cross\-sell, expansion, retention, or account revenue growth** 
 .
* Strong understanding of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer relationships.
* Strong stakeholder and relationship management skills.
* Experience interacting with senior decision\-makers.
* Strong commercial understanding and negotiation skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and project management abilities.
* Ability to coordinate multiple internal teams to deliver customer outcomes.
* Strong ownership and follow\-through.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience in
 **B2B SaaS, MarTech, CPaaS, CRM, FinTech, AI, automation, or technology** 
 .
* Experience with
 **WhatsApp Business API** 
 .
* Understanding of WhatsApp Marketing and conversational commerce.
* Experience managing large enterprise accounts.
* Experience with strategic account planning.
* Experience running QBRs / business reviews.
* Experience with customer expansion and land\-and\-expand models.
* Experience working with agencies, resellers, or technology partners.
* Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing and customer engagement.



  





**What Will Make You Stand Out** 



* You've
 **grown large enterprise accounts significantly** 
 .
* You can demonstrate measurable expansion or revenue growth from existing customers.
* You know how to find whitespace inside an account.
* You've successfully expanded relationships from one team/business unit to multiple.
* You can engage both users and senior decision\-makers.
* You understand customer business problems—not just product features.
* You know how to run a strong QBR and turn it into an account\-growth conversation.
* You proactively identify churn risks before they become problems.
* You can coordinate multiple teams and still own the final outcome.
* You have experience selling additional products into existing accounts.
* You can turn successful customers into references, case studies, and advocates.



  





**Why Join AiSensy?** 




  





**Work With Recognized Brands** 




 You'll work directly with businesses including
 **Adani, Vivo, PhysicsWallah, Godrej, Wipro, Asian Paints, India Today Group and more.** 




  





**Work on a High\-Impact Product** 




 Businesses use AiSensy to acquire, engage, sell, and support customers through WhatsApp.
 



 The product directly connects to customer engagement and revenue.
 



  





**Build Strategic Relationships** 




 You'll work with enterprise businesses and senior stakeholders rather than managing transactional accounts.
 



  





**Real Ownership** 




 You'll own:
 



**Relationship \+ Adoption \+ Retention \+ Expansion \+ Revenue** 




 Grow With the Category
 



  





 AiSensy is building across
 **WhatsApp Marketing, Click\-to\-WhatsApp Ads, AI Agents, conversational commerce, automation and payments** 
 .
 



 That gives you multiple opportunities to expand customer relationships as the platform grows.
 



  





**The Bottom Line** 




 We're looking for a
 **Key Account Manager who thinks beyond account management.** 




 Someone who can build relationships, understand the customer's business, identify opportunities, drive adoption, solve problems, and grow the account.
 



 Someone who doesn't wait for customers to ask:
 



**"What else can AiSensy do for us?"** 




 You should already know the answer.
 



 If you know how to turn enterprise customers into
 **long\-term, growing AiSensy accounts** 
 —
 



**come build with us.**

description:

 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes \- from emerging brands to Fortune 500s \- use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
   

  

 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 Operating at the intersection of logistics and tech has allowed Flexport to develop a unique value proposition that customers all over the globe love, resulting in exponential growth over the last 10 years. As part of our mission to make global trade easy for everyone, we are expanding and growing our sales organization in the India Subcontinent region.

You'll be part of a high\-performing team and in the driver's seat to establish our presence in the region, while providing tech\-enabled freight solutions that address customer needs.

**You Should Have:**

title: Brand Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Us** 




  





**Tooused** 
 powers circularity for India's leading brands, retailers, textile producers, and households.
 



  





**Tooused's** 
 vision is to divert 1 billion textiles from landfill by 2030, recycling them for a second life instead, and we’re on track to do it with India's first full\-stack textile recycling platform. This platform is setting the course for the future of the industry, connecting textile waste to responsible end\-of\-life options, meaningfully addressing the textile waste crisis, and redefining the sustainability narrative for the next generation – to one that is win\-win\-win for brands, consumers, and our planet.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 We are building
 **TakeBack** 
 for Brands. It gives a brand everything it needs to run its own take\-back programme without building any of it, including reverse logistics across the country, chain of custody on every garment, and the reporting brands will need as India's textile EPR rules take shape.
 



  





 We already have early interest from brands like NewMe, No Nasties, Mahina and Debaans. What we do not have yet is one person who owns this line end to end. That is this role.
 



  





 You will be the first commercial hire on
 **TakeBack** 
 . You will find the brands, run the pitch, close the deal, and then stay on to get the programme live with our ops and tech teams. This is not a role where you hand off after signature. At our stage, the person who sells it is the person who makes it work.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Build and run the brand pipeline, from cold outreach and events to inbound and referrals
* Own the full sales cycle, including discovery, pitch, commercials, negotiation and close
* Design each brand's take\-back programme with them, covering collection format, customer incentive, logistics flow and reporting
* Work with our ops and tech teams to launch signed brands and keep them running
* Be the brand's main point of contact after go\-live, and own renewal and expansion
* Build the pitch materials as you go, including decks, pricing models, and case studies
* Track what is and is not working in the funnel and tell us plainly
* Keep on top of EPR and textile regulation in India, and translate it into a reason for brands to act now



  





**What we are looking for** 





 This is a hands\-on commercial role with responsibility for building the pipeline, winning business, and getting programmes live.
 




  




* **2 to 5 years** 
 in B2B retail sales, partnerships, key accounts, or category management
* Background in fashion, retail, D2C, sustainability
* **Create opportunities proactively:** 
 You will research brands, identify decision\-makers, initiate outreach, and follow up consistently. The founders will support important conversations; you will own keeping opportunities moving.
* **Work towards agreed outcomes:** 
 We will set targets for qualified brand conversations, proposals, signed agreements, and programme launches. A qualified conversation should establish a relevant need, the decision\-making process, and a clear next step.
* **Keep the pipeline current:** 
 Record meaningful activity in our shared CRM or tracker by the next working day. Every active opportunity should show the contact, latest discussion, stage, next action, and follow\-up date.
* **Make progress and blockers visible:** 
 Share a weekly update covering what moved forward, what stalled, why, and what support you need. Raise risks early and recommend a next step.
* **Own delivery with the team:** 
 Confirm operational and technical feasibility before making commitments. After signature, coordinate the launch, track open issues, and keep the brand informed until they are resolved.
* **Ensure continuity:** 
 When an account changes hands or your engagement ends, provide an organised handover covering contacts, commitments, documents, pending actions, and timelines. Another team member should be able to continue the work from those records.



  





**What we are not looking for** 




  




* Someone who only wants to work warm inbound
* Someone who needs a fully built product, a fixed price list, and a finished deck on day one
* Someone who treats sustainability as a talking point rather than an operating problem



  





**Why this is worth your time** 




  





 Textile EPR is coming to India. When it lands, every mid and large apparel brand in the country will need a take\-back partner, and very few will want to build the infrastructure themselves. We already have the grid running. This role is the person who turns that into a business before the rules force everyone to catch up.
 



  





 You will report directly to the founder, and you will own the line rather than a slice of it. If it works, you build the team under it.
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 Fixed salary plus performance\-linked incentive on signed and launched brands. ESOPs on the table for the right person. We will talk numbers openly in the first call.
 



  





**How to apply** 




  





 Send your CV to hello@tooused.com with a short note on one brand you think should be running a take\-back programme in India and how you would get to them. We read those notes.

title: Channel Partner Acquisition Specialist
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are looking for an experienced Channel Partner Acquisition Specialist to build and grow our professional referral network across India. The role focuses on identifying, connecting with, onboarding and activating CA firms, CS firms, corporate service providers, business consultants and other professional intermediaries who work with entrepreneurs, business owners and companies requiring international business setup and corporate services. You will be responsible for developing these professional relationships and converting them into active referral channels for our business setup, UAE Free Zone and international corporate services offerings. This is a commercial channel\-development and relationship\-management role. A CA or CS qualification is not required. This is not an accounting, audit, taxation or company\-secretarial practice role. We are specifically interested in professionals who have previously worked with, sold to, onboarded or managed relationships with CA/CS firms and corporate service providers.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 





 • 
 
 Identify and approach relevant CA firms, CS firms, corporate service providers, business consultants and professional advisory firms across India.
 




 • 
 
 Build relationships with decision\-makers within professional\-services firms and referral networks.
 




 • 
 
 Present our international business setup, UAE Free Zone and corporate services offerings to potential channel partners.
 




 • 
 
 Onboard qualified partners into the company's channel program and ensure a smooth activation
 



 process.
 




 • 
 
 Educate partners on our service portfolio, referral process, commercial model and client journey.
 




 • 
 
 Maintain consistent engagement with onboarded partners to generate qualified client referrals.
 




 • 
 
 Conduct meetings, presentations, calls and follow\-ups with prospective and existing channel partners.
 




 • 
 
 Develop new referral opportunities through networking, professional associations, industry events and direct outreach.
 




 • 
 
 Maintain an organised pipeline of prospective, onboarding and active channel partners.
 




 • 
 
 Coordinate internally with sales, operations and client\-service teams to ensure referred clients receive appropriate support.
 




 • 
 
 Monitor partner activity, referral volumes, conversion performance and relationship health.
 




 • 
 
 Re\-engage inactive partners and identify opportunities to increase referral activity.
 




 • 
 
 Provide market feedback on partner requirements, competitor activity and potential new channel
 



 opportunities.
 




 • 
 
 Represent the company professionally in meetings with external advisors and service providers.
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




 The strongest candidates will have practical experience in channel acquisition, channel sales, partner onboarding, referral\-network development or business development involving professional\-service providers.
 



  





**Relevant experience may include working with:** 





 • 
 
 CA and accounting firms
 




 • 
 
 Company Secretary firms
 




 • 
 
 Corporate service providers
 




 • 
 
 Business setup or company formation firms
 




 • 
 
 Tax and business advisory firms
 




 • 
 
 Legal or compliance service providers
 




 • 
 
 SME\-focused consultants and professional referral networks
 



 You should be comfortable building relationships from the first conversation through onboarding, activation and ongoing account development.
 



  





**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS** 





 • 
 
 Prior experience building or managing a network of professional referral/channel partners.
 




 • 
 
 Demonstrable experience dealing with CA firms, CS firms and/or corporate service providers.
 




 • 
 
 Strong business\-development, relationship\-management and negotiation skills.
 




 • 
 
 Ability to independently prospect, arrange meetings and develop new professional relationships.
 




 • 
 
 Strong presentation and consultative selling skills.
 




 • 
 
 Ability to understand business setup and corporate\-service solutions and explain them clearly to
 



 partners.
 




 • 
 
 Commercial mindset with a strong focus on partner activation and qualified referral generation.
 




 • 
 
 Comfortable working with CRM systems, partner pipelines and performance reporting.
 




 • 
 
 Strong professional communication skills.
 




 • 
 
 Experience in UAE business setup, Free Zones, international company formation, corporate services or related sectors would be an advantage.
 



  





**IDEAL BACKGROUND** 




**Candidates may come from backgrounds such as:** 





 • 
 
 Channel Sales
 




 • 
 
 Channel Partner Management
 




 • 
 
 Partner Acquisition
 




 • 
 
 Referral Network Development
 




 • 
 
 Business Development
 




 • 
 
 Corporate Services
 




 • 
 
 Business Setup / Company Formation
 




 • 
 
 Fintech or SME Services
 




 • 
 
 Professional Services Sales
 




 • 
 
 B2B2C or intermediary\-led sales models
 



 Experience working directly with a professional network of advisors or service providers will be particularly
 
 relevant.
 




  





**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE** 




**Success will be measured by your ability to:** 





 • 
 
 Build a strong pipeline of relevant professional partners.
 




 • 
 
 Convert prospective partners into active referral relationships.
 




 • 
 
 Develop productive long\-term relationships with CA, CS and corporate\-service networks.
 




 • 
 
 Generate consistent qualified business opportunities through the channel.
 




 • 
 
 Increase the number of active and revenue\-contributing partners.
 




 • 
 
 Maintain disciplined partner follow\-up, reporting and pipeline management.
 



 The role is not focused only on signing partners. The objective is to build a productive and commercially active channel network.
 



  





**WHY THIS ROLE** 




 This position offers the opportunity to develop a professional partner ecosystem across India while working with solutions related to UAE business setup, international expansion and corporate services. You will have ownership of partner acquisition and relationship development and will work closely with the wider sales and operations teams to convert professional relationships into sustainable business channels.
 



  





**WORK LOCATION** 




 This is primarily a work\-from\-office position based in Delhi, India.
 



 The role may involve meetings with prospective and existing channel partners, industry networking and occasional business travel depending on requirements.
 



  





**IMPORTANT CLARIFICATION** 




 This vacancy is for a Channel Partner Acquisition / Business Development professional.
 



 It is not a practicing CA, CS, accounting, audit, tax\-filing or company\-secretarial position.
 



 We welcome candidates who understand the professional\-services ecosystem and have experience building commercial relationships with CA firms, CS firms, corporate\-service providers or similar advisory businesses.
 



  





**EMPLOYMENT TYPE** 
**Full\-time** 




**WORK MODEL** 
**On\-site / Work from Office** 




**FUNCTION** 
**Channel Acquisition / Business Development / B2C Growth** 




  





**APPLY** 




 If you have experience developing professional referral networks, onboarding channel partners and building relationships with CA, CS or corporate\-service firms, we would be interested in speaking with you.

title: Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating-cooling system)
description:
**Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating\-cooling system)** 




**Zehnder Group \| Represented in India by T\&A Consulting** 




**Location: Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru** 




  





**About Zehnder Group** 




 Zehnder Group is a Swiss headquartered provider of world\-leading solutions for a comfortable, energy\-efficient and healthy indoor climate. The products and services of the Group include heating, cooling, indoor ventilation and air cleaning. The Group develops and manufactures its products at its own factories in Europe, China, and North America.
 



 As part of its international growth strategy, Zehnder is now entering the Indian market and is looking to appoint Country Manager – India.
 



**More about Zehnder Group on www.zehndergroup.com** 




 Zehnder has partnered with
 **T\&A Consulting** 
 to support its India market entry and leadership hiring.
 



  





**About T\&A Consulting** 




 T\&A Consulting is a global advisory firm, with extensive experience of working with government, economic development agencies, businesses and academic institutions across Europe, Asia, and the Americas towards their expansion in the international markets.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Country Manager – India who will be responsible for building Zehnder’s business in India from the ground up.
 



 This is not a conventional sales role. It is a
 **market\-entry, business development and category\-building role** 
 for a senior commercial professional who can create demand for premium indoor climate solutions in India.
 



 The role requires someone who can position Zehnder as a premium ventilation, fresh\-air and indoor air quality brand in India, build specification\-led demand, develop a strong project pipeline, create the right partner ecosystem, and secure early reference projects.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable operating in a lean, entrepreneurial setup where brand awareness, channels, installer capability and market acceptance need to be built from scratch.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. India Market Entry \& Business Build\-Up** 



* Establish Zehnder’s presence in India.
* Develop and execute a practical go\-to\-market plan for India.
* Identify priority customer segments, geographies and project types.
* Build Zehnder’s visibility among architects, consultants, developers, contractors and premium project decision\-makers.
* Generate qualified project pipeline and secure early reference projects.
* Provide regular market intelligence, competitor insights and customer feedback to Zehnder’s global leadership team.



  





**2\. Ventilation, Fresh\-Air \& Indoor Climate Business Development** 



* Lead market development for Zehnder’s balanced energy recovery ventilation systems
 **(ERV/ HRV, fresh air)** 
 with focus on the residential market.
* Build demand around the need for healthy indoor air, controlled ventilation, humidity management, energy efficiency and premium indoor comfort.
* Educate the market on the difference between air purification, air\-conditioning and engineered balanced energy recovery ventilation systems.
* Position Zehnder as a premium, technically superior and performance\-led indoor climate solution provider.



  





**3\. Premium / Luxury Project Sales** 



* Identify and develop opportunities in premium and luxury building projects.
* Target relevant segments such as luxury residential developments, branded residences, HNI villas, premium apartments, wellness spaces, high\-end hospitality, international schools, healthcare and select green building projects.
* Build relationships with premium developers, architects, interior designers, consultants, villa owners, project owners and HNI\-focused ecosystem partners.
* Sell on value, performance, comfort, health, acoustics, energy efficiency and lifecycle benefit, not on price alone.



  





**4\. Specification \& Project Sales** 



* Drive specification\-led selling by engaging architects, MEP consultants, HVAC consultants, green building consultants, PMCs, developers and contractors.
* Influence projects at the design and specification stage, before tendering and commercial negotiation.
* Develop technical presentations, concept notes and project\-specific value propositions.
* Support the creation of BOQ inputs, specification language, product comparisons, technical submittals and project proposals.
* Ensure that Zehnder is positioned as a system solution, not merely a product or equipment supplier.



  





**5\. Partner Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, evaluate and develop suitable channel partners, system partners, installers, integrators and commissioning partners.
* Build a limited but high\-quality partner network capable of selling, installing and servicing premium ventilation systems.
* Train partners on Zehnder’s product value proposition, installation standards, commissioning discipline and customer experience expectations.
* Ensure that partners have the capability to support premium projects and maintain Zehnder’s brand standards.
* Develop a partner model that protects pricing, service quality, installation quality and long\-term customer satisfaction.



  





**6\. Technical Selling \& Customer Education** 



* Explain Zehnder’s solutions convincingly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Communicate the benefits of balanced ventilation, fresh\-air supply, energy recovery, humidity control, filtration, low\-noise operation and indoor air quality.
* Conduct presentations, seminars, consultant meetings, architect discussions, CPD\-style sessions and industry engagements.
* Build awareness among the market that premium indoor climate is about air quality, comfort, health and performance \- not only cooling.



  





**7\. Brand Representation \& Executive Presence** 



* Act as the face of Zehnder in India.
* Represent the company in senior client meetings, industry forums, trade events, consultant interactions and partner discussions.
* Build credibility with Indian stakeholders while maintaining alignment with Zehnder’s European quality, brand and business standards.
* Communicate clearly with Zehnder’s global leadership team on India market realities, opportunities, challenges and progress.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





**Experience** 



* 10–15 years of experience in HVAC, ventilation, building technology, indoor air quality, air filtration, fresh\-air systems, ERV/HRV, heat recovery, energy recovery, related technical building solutions.
* Experience in premium or specification\-led project sales is strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to international companies, European brands, premium technical products or MNC environments will be an advantage.
* Experience in building a new business vertical, product category, region, partner network or market from an early stage will be highly valued.



  





**Product / Sector Exposure** 




 The ideal candidate should have exposure to one or more of the following:
 


* **Balanced energy recovery ventilation systems (ERV/ HRV, fresh air)**
* **Residential ventilation systems**
* Heat recovery / energy recovery
* Indoor air quality solutions
* Air filtration / clean\-air solutions
* Premium HVAC systems
* Green building / energy\-efficient building solutions



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for a commercially strong, self\-driven professional with a builder mindset. The right candidate will be someone who has the maturity of working with international companies, but also the agility, ownership, and entrepreneurial drive required to build a business in a new market.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 ▪ Strong business development and pipeline creation capability
 



 ▪ Ability to build markets, channels, and partnerships from the ground up
 



 ▪ Commercially sharp and opportunity\-driven
 



 ▪ Strong network in HVAC / ventilation / building technology ecosystem
 



 ▪ Good understanding of specification\-led and project\-led sales
 



 ▪ Ability to work independently with limited local infrastructure
 



 ▪ High ownership, initiative, and accountability
 



 ▪ Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 



 ▪ Comfortable working with international leadership teams
 



 ▪ Strategic thinking with hands\-on execution capability
 



  





**Why This Role Is Exciting** 




 ▪ Opportunity to lead the India market entry for a respected European brand
 



 ▪ First commercial leadership role for Zehnder in India
 



 ▪ High ownership and visibility with global leadership
 



 ▪ Opportunity to shape market strategy, channel structure, and early business growth
 



 ▪ Ideal role for a professional who enjoys building, not just managing.

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Inventory Liquidation \& Stock Optimization Manager**

 **Auto Spare Parts \& Accessories industry** 
 .
 



 The role will be responsible for ensuring that inventory remains
 **liquid, productive and commercially viable** 
 , with a strong focus on reducing ageing, slow\-moving and non\-moving stock and preventing unnecessary inventory accumulation. The ideal candidate should have strong
 **market/customer connect, inventory analytics, pricing \& discounting expertise, and commercial understanding** 
 to convert inventory into sales while protecting
 



 margins.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Inventory Liquidation \& Ageing Management
 * Analyse inventory ageing across SKU, brand, category, model and location.
* Develop and execute liquidation plans for
 **slow\-moving, non\-moving, obsolete and excess inventory** 
 .
* Define SKU\-wise liquidation priorities based on ageing, value, demand and margin.
* Monitor inventory turnover and ensure continuous stock movement.
* Develop mechanisms to prevent inventory from becoming stagnant.



  




 2\. Data \& Inventory Analytics
 * Analyse
 **inventory ageing, stock holding, sell\-through, inventory turnover, sales velocity and SKU performance** 
 .
* Prepare regular MIS and dashboards for inventory movement and liquidation.
* Identify dead stock and excess inventory through data\-driven analysis.
* Analyse customer purchase patterns and historical sales to identify potential buyers for specific inventory.
* Track liquidation value, recovery value, discount impact and margin realization.



  




 3\. Customer \& Market Development
 * Build and maintain a strong network of
 **distributors, dealers, retailers, workshops and other trade customers** 
 .
* Proactively approach customers for specific slow\-moving or excess SKUs.
* Map available inventory against customer demand and market requirements.
* Develop alternate sales channels for products with low regular movement.
* Maintain strong market intelligence on pricing, demand and competitor activity.



  




 4\. Pricing \& Discount Management
 * Design
 **SKU\-wise/customer\-wise discount structures** 
 for inventory liquidation.
* Determine appropriate discount levels based on stock ageing, purchase cost, market price and expected recovery.
* Balance liquidation speed with
 **gross margin and contribution margin** 
 .
* Develop promotional/bulk\-buying offers for ageing inventory.
* Monitor the impact of discounts on inventory recovery and profitability.



  




 5\. Commercial \& Working Capital Management
 * Focus on reducing
 **working capital blocked in inventory** 
 .
* Monitor inventory value versus sales velocity.
* Identify opportunities to convert dormant inventory into cash.
* Coordinate with Finance, Sales, Purchase and Warehouse teams for liquidation decisions.
* Recommend purchase controls based on inventory performance and demand trends.



  




 6\. Process \& Control

* Create ageing buckets and liquidation action plans.
* Set up regular review mechanisms for
 **30/60/90/120\+ day inventory** 
 .

* Maintain accurate records of liquidation activities, pricing approvals and customer conversions.



  




 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 * Inventory Turnover Ratio
* Reduction in 90\+/120\+ day ageing inventory
* Slow \& Non\-Moving Inventory Reduction
* Inventory Liquidation Value
* Inventory Recovery %
* Stock\-to\-Sales Ratio
* Gross Margin / Contribution Margin
* Discount vs. Recovery Analysis
* Working Capital Released
* SKU Sell\-Through Rate
* Reduction in Dead Stock



  




 Candidate Profile
 * **5–12 years of relevant experience** 
 in inventory liquidation, inventory management, commercial operations, sales or stock optimization.
* **Mandatory experience in Auto Spare Parts \& Accessories industry.**
* Strong understanding of
 **automotive spare parts, accessories, brands, applications and aftermarket distribution** 
 .
* Strong customer and market network in the automotive aftermarket.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **inventory ageing and liquidation strategies** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of pricing, discounting, margins and commercial negotiations.
* Advanced Excel/MIS and strong data interpretation skills.
* Experience working with
 **ERP/inventory management systems** 
 .
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and take commercially sound decisions.



  




 Ideal Candidate
 
 The ideal candidate is someone who understands that
 **inventory is not an asset if it is not moving** 
 . The person should be commercially strong, highly data\-driven and well connected with the automotive aftermarket, with the ability to convert
 **ageing and excess inventory into sales and cash while protecting margins** 
 .

title: Sales & GTM Intern
description:
\# Sales \& GTM — Founder's Office
 





 Company: GaiN.videoRole: Sales \& GTM Intern — Founder's OfficeLocation: Remote / NCR regionDuration: 6 monthsType: InternshipReporting to: Founder
 




  





  






 About GaiN
 





 GaiN is an AI\-native video creation platform built for businesses.
 





 Businesses today need to create product videos, sales enablement content, training videos, explainers, educational content and marketing videos constantly. Traditionally, producing these videos requires writers, designers, video editors, motion designers and multiple rounds of coordination.
 




  






 GaiN brings much of this workflow into one AI\-native platform—helping businesses turn ideas, documents, websites and product information into high\-quality business videos dramatically faster.
 





 We are building GaiN for teams that have a recurring need to communicate complex information through video across marketing, sales, L\&D, HR, product, customer education and training.
 




  





  






 We are now looking for a Sales \& GTM Intern to work directly with the Founder and help build GaiN's early sales and go\-to\-market engine.
 





 This is not a conventional sales internship.
 





 You will not simply be handed a list of leads and asked to send cold emails.
 





 You will help us answer questions like:
 





 Who should GaiN sell to? Why would they buy? How do we identify companies that are likely to need us right now? Who is the right person to contact? Which messages work? Which partnerships can unlock distribution? And how can we turn interest into revenue?
 





 \-\-\-
 




  






 What You Will Work On
 





 1\. Founder\-led outbound sales
 





 Work directly with the Founder to turn his existing network and professional connections into potential business opportunities.
 





 You will:
 





 \* Research relevant prospects within the Founder's LinkedIn network and broader network.\* Identify the right decision\-makers within target companies.\* Understand the company and its likely use case before reaching out.\* Write personalized LinkedIn messages and follow\-ups.\* Start conversations and qualify potential opportunities.\* Maintain a structured prospect pipeline.\* Track outreach, responses, meetings and opportunities.\* Continuously improve messaging based on what you learn from the market.
 





 The goal is not to maximize the number of messages sent.
 





 \*\*The goal is to create meaningful conversations with the right prospects.\*\*
 





 \-\-\-
 





 2\. Deep prospect research \& buying\-signal identification
 





 A major part of this role will be figuring out \*\*which companies are likely to have a real need for GaiN.\*\*
 





 You will research companies and identify signals such as:
 





 \* Hiring for AI video editors, video producers, motion designers or content creators.\* Increasing investment in content or video production.\* Digital marketing and creative agencies managing large volumes of video work.\* SaaS and technology companies frequently launching products or features.\* Companies with large sales enablement, L\&D, training or customer education teams.\* Organizations producing recurring training or educational content.\* Companies actively adopting AI for content or marketing workflows.\* Other business events that indicate a potential need for faster video production.
 





 You will learn to move from:
 





 "This company looks interesting."
 





 to:
 





 "This company has a specific signal that suggests GaiN may be valuable to them."
 





 \-\-\-
 





 3\. Build highly curated prospect lists
 





 Research target markets, industries, companies and personas and build structured prospect lists.
 





 Your research should connect:
 





 Company → Buying signal → Use case → Decision\-maker → Contact → Outreach angle
 





 You may also help experiment with different:
 





 \* Industries\* Geographies\* Company sizes\* Buyer personas\* Use cases\* Messaging\* Outreach channels
 





 The objective is to understand \*\*where GaiN has the strongest product\-market and sales potential.\*\*
 





 \-\-\-
 





 4\. Targeted email outreach
 





 Execute outbound email campaigns against highly researched prospect lists.
 





 You will:
 





 \* Research prospects before contacting them.\* Write personalized outbound emails.\* Develop different messaging angles.\* Manage follow\-ups.\* Track open/reply/meeting outcomes where applicable.\* Maintain CRM and pipeline hygiene.\* Identify patterns in what prospects respond to.\* Help continuously improve GaiN's outbound playbook.
 





 \-\-\-
 





 5\. Strategic partnerships \& distribution
 





 This will be a significant part of the role.
 





 Instead of only asking:
 





 \*\*"Who can buy GaiN?"\*\*
 





 you will also explore:
 





 \*\*"Who already has access to the customers GaiN wants?"\*\*
 





 Research and approach potential:
 





 \* Digital marketing agencies\* Creative and video agencies\* AI product companies\* SaaS companies\* Software resellers\* Technology partners\* L\&D and training companies\* Consultants\* Communities and ecosystem partners\* Media and content partners\* Other organizations that could distribute or recommend GaiN
 





 You will help explore models such as:
 





 \* Referral partnerships\* Reseller relationships\* Agency partnerships\* Co\-marketing\* Bundled offerings\* Portfolio partnerships\* Strategic distribution
 





 \-\-\-
 





 6\. Convert inbound \& marketing leads
 





 GaiN generates interest through content, social media, product activity and other marketing initiatives.
 





 You will help turn that interest into qualified sales conversations.
 





 This may involve:
 





 \* Monitoring incoming leads and sign\-ups.\* Identifying high\-potential MQLs.\* Researching the company and person behind the lead.\* Prioritizing prospects based on buying potential.\* Reaching out to qualified leads.\* Understanding their current video/content workflow.\* Identifying their pain points and use cases.\* Moving qualified leads toward demos and trial activation.\* Following up with users who demonstrate buying intent.
 





 The objective is:
 





 \*\*Interest → Conversation → Product Experience → Qualified Opportunity\*\*
 





 \-\-\-
 





 7\. Product demos \& trial activation
 





 For high\-potential prospects, you will assist with and eventually take ownership of product demonstrations.
 





 You will learn to:
 





 \* Understand the prospect's use case before the demo.\* Tailor the demonstration to their business problem.\* Show the most relevant GaiN workflows.\* Help prospects create their first video.\* Follow up after trial activation.\* Identify objections and blockers.\* Feed customer feedback back to the Founder and product team.\* Understand what turns a trial into a paying customer.
 





 Over time, strong performers should be capable of taking a prospect from \*\*initial conversation to product activation.\*\*
 





 \-\-\-
 





 8\. VC portfolio \& ecosystem strategy
 





 We want to build relationships that create leverage rather than pursuing every customer individually.
 





 You will research venture capital funds, accelerators, startup communities and other ecosystems whose portfolios could contain hundreds of potential GaiN customers.
 





 For example:
 





 \*\*Which VC funds have portfolio companies that are likely to have a recurring need for product marketing, sales enablement, training or business video?\*\*
 





 You will help develop strategies such as:
 





 \* Portfolio\-wide GaiN offers\* Founder benefits\* Startup programs\* Portfolio enablement\* Workshops and demos\* Community partnerships\* Preferred vendor relationships\* Co\-marketing
 





 This part of the role requires thinking beyond individual deals and looking for \*\*high\-leverage distribution opportunities.\*\*
 





 \-\-\-
 





 9\. GTM research \& experimentation
 





 Because GaiN is building its market, this role will also contribute directly to our go\-to\-market strategy.
 





 You will investigate questions such as:
 





 \* Which industries show the strongest demand?\* Which buyer personas respond most?\* Which use cases create the most urgency?\* What are customers currently using instead?\* What objections come up repeatedly?\* Which competitors are prospects evaluating?\* Which outreach channels produce qualified opportunities?\* Which buying signals correlate with actual interest?\* Which partnership models can create repeatable distribution?
 





 You will help turn these observations into \*\*practical GTM experiments.\*\*
 





 \-\-\-
 





 What Success Looks Like
 





 We care about \*\*quality, learning velocity and real business impact\*\*, not vanity metrics.
 





 You will be evaluated on:
 





 \* Quality of prospect research.\* Ability to identify strong buying signals.\* Number and quality of qualified opportunities generated.\* Outreach quality and response rates.\* Meetings and demos generated.\* Trial activations and sales opportunities created.\* Strategic partnerships identified and initiated.\* Quality of GTM experiments.\* Ability to identify useful market patterns.\* Speed of execution.\* Ownership and independence.
 





 A great outcome from this internship is not simply:
 





 \*\*"I sent 1,000 emails."\*\*
 





 It is:
 





 \*\*"I discovered a segment where GaiN has strong demand, figured out why, built a repeatable outreach approach, generated qualified opportunities and identified a scalable way to reach more companies."\*\*
 





 \-\-\-
 




  





  






 \#\# Who We Are Looking For
 





 We are looking for someone who is \*\*curious, driven, commercially minded and comfortable figuring things out independently.\*\*
 





 You do not need years of sales experience.
 





 You do need the mindset of someone who enjoys finding answers.
 




  






 You may be a strong fit if you:

title: Regional Sales Manager - North India
description:
**ABOUT AVERY DENNISON CORPORATION** 




 Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency, and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio\-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital, and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e\-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in more than 50 countries. Our reported sales in 2024 were $8\.8 billion. Learn more at
 
 www.averydennison.com
 
 .
 



**Job Description** 




**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 The Regional Sales Manager will be responsible for driving the overall business performance of the North India region, delivering the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), managing channel partners, developing new business opportunities, and leading the regional sales team.
 



 The role will have end\-to\-end responsibility for top\-line growth, profitability, collections, market development, customer engagement, channel excellence, and people development.

* Deliver the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) for the designated North India region.

* Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with business objectives and market opportunities.
* Deliver bottom\-line profitability through effective pricing, product\-mix optimization, and commercial discipline.
* Manage and improve timely collection of accounts receivables in line with company targets.
* Build strong relationships with distributors, printers, converters, and key decision\-makers.
* Strengthen channel partner engagement, capability, productivity, and business development.
* Identify opportunities for market expansion, share gain, new applications, and innovation\-led growth.
* Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and ensure effective resolution of customer concerns.
* Lead negotiations with key customers and channel partners and convert discussions into sustainable business outcomes.
* Develop and coach the regional sales team to achieve business and individual objectives.
* Create a high\-performance culture through regular reviews, coaching, feedback, and capability development.
* Work as a strong team player with a high level of ownership, self\-motivation, and accountability.
* Demonstrate strong business acumen and proficiency in Excel, data analysis, and sales performance management.



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE** 




  





**1\. Business \& Sales Management** 



* Own regional sales, volume, revenue, margin, and profitability targets.
* Develop and execute annual and quarterly regional business plans.
* Drive growth through existing channel partners while identifying and onboarding new partners where required.
* Identify white spaces and opportunities for geographic, customer, product, and application expansion.
* Monitor market trends, customer needs, competitor activity, pricing, and market dynamics.
* Track regional KPIs and take timely corrective actions to deliver business objectives.
* Maintain strong sales discipline through regular pipeline, forecast, and business reviews.



**2\. Channel Partner Management** 



* **D** 
 evelop strong strategic relationships with distributors and channel partners across North India.
* Establish clear business plans and growth objectives with key channel partners.
* Improve distributor productivity, inventory management, market coverage, and customer reach.
* Drive channel partner engagement initiatives, business reviews, capability\-building programs, and joint market development activities.
* Ensure healthy channel inventory and working\-capital discipline.
* Identify and resolve channel conflicts while maintaining a healthy and sustainable channel ecosystem.
* Develop new channel opportunities in underpenetrated markets.



  





**3\. People Management \& Leadership** 



* Lead, motivate, coach, and develop the regional sales team.
* Set clear objectives, KPIs, and performance expectations for team members.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback and coaching.
* Build team capability in consultative selling, negotiation, account management, market development, and commercial excellence.
* Encourage collaboration, accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Identify talent and develop succession plans for critical roles.
* Ensure effective communication of business priorities and company initiatives to the team.
* Lead by example and demonstrate strong ethical, customer\-focused, and performance\-oriented leadership.



  





**4\. Regional Travel** 



* Extensive travel across the North India region will be required.
* Regular visits to distributors, customers, printers/converters, and key market locations.
* Participate in customer meetings, channel partner reviews, market development activities, trials, exhibitions, and business events.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




  




* BE / B.Tech or MBA in Sales/Marketing will be an added advantage.

**Knowledge \& Personality Traits** 



* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills with customers, channel partners, peers, and team members.

**Sales \& People Management** 



* Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end B2B selling process and ability to influence and coach the team in effective selling practices.

* Strong negotiation and key\-account management skills.
* Understanding of pricing, costing, margin, and product\-mix models..



  





**Behavioral Attributes** 



* Go\-Getter: High energy, passion for excellence, bias for action, and strong ownership.
* People Leader: Ability to inspire, coach, develop, and motivate a diverse team.
* Customer Focused: Strong commitment to customer success and long\-term relationships.
* Resilient: Adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic and competitive environment.
* Collaborative: Ability to work effectively across functions and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

 Formulate and ensure realization of local sales strategy in order to meet the established sales quota for the area of responsibility, and lead the daily operation of Haworth’s sales and distribution functions ensuring that Haworth’s customers in the assigned market consistently receive high\-quality products and services in a timely manner.

* Prepare budgets, sales plans, forecasts, and relevant sales reporting.

**Your Qualifications:**
* Any Graduate, with MBA in Sales and Marketing.
* 12\-15 years of experience in managing cross\-functional teams including Sales and Marketing Functions. Minimum of 5 years of experience in the building material industry is a must.
* Must have experience of managing complex sales cycles with B\-to\-B selling processes in multinational companies.
* Demonstrated experience in identifying new and emerging opportunities, and developing and implementing strategic initiatives.
* Can apply an in\-depth understanding of the industry and competitors’ products to deliver value to customers and the organization.

* Should be able to create and drive a high\-performing team.


**About Us**
 Haworth is one of the world's largest manufacturers of office furniture, providing solutions for tomorrow's customers worldwide. At the center of our work is the human being: What does a person need to work, what pushes them, motivate them and what makes people feel comfortable at work? Only if we can answer that question, we are able to introduce designs to our customers that will make them achieve their goals. To stay one step ahead, we invest in our own research, have a worldwide network of interesting partners and are part of think tanks around the world who are trying to think ahead. The family\-owned company, headquartered in Holland, Michigan/United States, employs more than 8,000 people and is represented in more than 150 countries in Asia, Europe and America with subsidiaries and partners.
