title: Sales Operations & AI Business Intelligence Manager
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
   

  

*SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.*
**Who We Are**
 At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best in class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out of the box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software.
   

  

 To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they’ve always been done.
   

  

 What We’re Looking For
   

  

 SOTI’s growth and success is a result of commitment to innovation through entrepreneurial culture and leadership. We’re looking for a Sales Operations \& AI Business Intelligence Manager who wants to do three things at once: run the operating engine behind a global sales organization, lead and grow a team of business analysts and operations professionals, and act as SOTI’s subject matter expert for AI\-driven reporting.
   

  

 This is an outstanding opportunity to decide how a global sales organization sees itself. You will own the numbers our sales leaders run the business on, the team that produces them, and the shift from manual reporting toward AI\-assisted, self\-serve intelligence. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, enjoy working with emerging technologies, and want your fingerprints on how a market leader sells, this role puts you at the centre of it.
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
 The People – From our humble origins in our founder’s basement, to our industry leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation and fun.
   

  

 The Growth – Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast\-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big!
   

  

 The Technology – You’ll get the chance to work with leading edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects, as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners, which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Run the local sales operations engine
   

  

* Support execution of annual and quarterly business planning with India regional sales leaders, keeping the focus on plan execution and the ability to get to quarterly targets.
* Own forecast reporting, variance analysis, funnel reviews and top opportunity analysis for sales leaders, and drive accurate forecasting through sales process best practice, pipeline management and opportunity hygiene.
* Identify risk in the forecast, build mitigation plans and hold regional teams accountable to delivering their quarterly numbers.
* Provide analysis across pricing and deal structure trends, revenue streams and product sets to advise on future go\-to\-market initiatives, and act as a point on non\-standard deal structuring requests.
* Maintain a single, defensible set of definitions for pipeline, bookings, coverage, conversion and forecast accuracy, and hold the organization to them.
* Drive continual improvement of sales tools and process to streamline the sales cycle, and execute effective change management across the organization when process, systems or tools change.


**Lead and grow the India Data, Analytics, Reporting team**
* Lead, coach and develop a team of business analysts and sales operations professionals, setting clear standards for analytical rigour and delivery.
* Run a consistent people cadence: regular one\-on\-ones, documented goals, mid\-year and annual reviews, and honest, timely feedback.
* Plan capacity and assign work across competing priorities, protecting the team from thrash while keeping commitments to stakeholders.
* Build the team’s AI and analytics capability deliberately, through training, pairing and hands\-on projects, so that expertise is never concentrated in one person.
* Own team decisions and be accountable for team outcomes, including hiring, onboarding and retention of key talent.


**Lead AI reporting and business intelligence**
* Act as SOTI’s internal subject matter expert for AI\-driven business intelligence — evaluating platforms and capabilities, and making clear build, buy or defer recommendations.
* Own the reporting and dashboard roadmap, from source data in Salesforce and connected systems through to semantic models, dashboards and self\-serve analytics.
* Apply machine learning and generative AI where they demonstrably improve outcomes: forecast accuracy, pipeline risk detection, renewal and expansion signals, and narrative reporting.
* Ensure data integrity, accuracy and compliance across Salesforce and integrated systems, and participate in user acceptance testing to validate system changes.
* Drive adoption through enablement sessions and clear usage guidance, and measure whether the tools are genuinely changing how decisions get made.
* Establish guardrails for data quality, access, privacy and responsible AI use in partnership with IT and Security, and document how automated outputs are validated.


**Partner across the business**
* Facilitate stakeholder sessions to gather requirements, align expectations and drive consensus across functions with competing priorities.
* Lead complex projects from inception to closure, managing scope, timelines, dependencies, risk and deliverables.
* Work with sales enablement to train and onboard new sales team members on process, tooling and reporting.
* Translate between technical and non\-technical audiences, presenting the same insight credibly to a data engineer and to a regional sales leader.


**Experience You Will Bring**
* MBA from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school.
* 8\+ years of post\-MBA experience across sales, revenue or business operations within a high\-growth technology organisation; enterprise SaaS experience is a distinct advantage.
* Proven track record of leading teams of analysts or consultants, with direct people management accountability rather than project\-only leadership.
* Demonstrated depth in business intelligence, including hands\-on experience taking AI, machine learning or advanced analytics capabilities into production use — not only evaluating them.
* Strong business, commercial and financial acumen, with a proven ability to develop structured business plans, craft KPIs and implement metrics to manage sales execution and performance.
* Advanced Excel and BI platform skills with working fluency in SQL; Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst certification preferred, along with a strong understanding of CRM processes.
* Strong initiative, intellectual curiosity and analytical capability, with a willingness to take ownership of complex problems and a resourceful approach to clearing obstacles.
* Exceptional organisational and time management skills, able to manage competing projects against tight deadlines.
* Collaborative team player with exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable working with senior management and cultivating relationships across cross\-functional teams and peers.


**About SOTI**
 SOTI is the world's most trusted provider of mobile and IoT management solutions, with more than 17,000 enterprise customers and millions of devices managed worldwide. SOTI's innovative portfolio of solutions and services provide the tools organizations need to truly mobilize their operations and optimize their mobility investments. SOTI extends secure mobility management to provide a total, flexible solution for comprehensive management and security of all mobile devices and connected peripherals deployed in an organization.
   

  

 At SOTI, we celebrate the uniqueness of our global teams and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are curious problem solvers who are committed to bringing the best mobile and IoT management solutions to market. We offer careers with \#EndlessPossibilities.
   

  

 What are you waiting for? Apply today: soti.net/careers
   

  

 If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

 At its core is one of the world's most comprehensive proprietary trade data foundations comprising tariff schedules, customs rulings, duties, taxes, FTAs, import\-export controls, ECN schedules, export licenses from 140\+ countries; 675 sanctions and PEP lists, UBO, OFAC/EU/UK/BIS 50 relationships, global entity identifiers and corporate registry data; AIS datafeed connectivity; 3\.5 billion shipment records from more than 35 countries and more. This data powers TrademoKG, Trademo's proprietary knowledge graph.
 



 Built on top of this foundation, purpose\-built AI agents automate critical trade workflows. Prism digitizes and extracts data from trade documents, Clara streamlines sanctions adjudication, dedicated agents accelerate HS and ECCN classification, and Hermes helps enterprises discover suppliers, identify buyers, and uncover new trade opportunities. Together, they transform complex trade data into actionable decisions in minutes instead of days.
 



 Founded in 2020 by third\-time entrepreneur Shalabh Singhal, an alumnus of IIT BHU, the CFA Institute, and Stanford GSB Seed, Trademo has raised $12\.5 million in seed funding from Amit Singhal (former SVP, Google), Sridhar Ramaswamy (CEO, Snowflake), Neeraj Arora (former Chief Business Officer, WhatsApp), and Saama Capital.
 



 Trademo's vision is to enable enterprises to source smarter, win new business, stay compliant with evolving regulations, and build resilient supply chains in an increasingly complex world.

title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description:
Enterprise Sales Manager — Fintech \& Banking
 



 TARA AI Labs / GoCredit \| Delhi NCR
 



  





 You understand how lenders buy. You have earned their trust. You know how to turn a complex conversation into a signed enterprise deal.
 



  





 We should talk.
 



  





 At TARA AI Labs and GoCredit, we’re building technology that helps lenders make better credit decisions and consumers access credit more intelligently.
 



  





 Our enterprise product,
 **Sentinel** 
 , brings AI\-powered credit risk intelligence and underwriting to lenders—helping them evaluate borrowers, structure offers and make better\-informed lending decisions. GoCredit connects consumers with lending partners through an AI\-powered credit platform.
 



  





 We’re looking for an accomplished
 **Enterprise Sales Manager** 
 to build deep relationships with banks, NBFCs and digital lenders, and turn those relationships into meaningful, long\-term business.
 



  





**The opportunity** 




  





 You will own the enterprise sales cycle—from identifying the right institutions and opening senior\-level conversations to building the business case, navigating evaluations, negotiating commercials and closing.
 



  





 This role calls for someone who combines a strong lender network with exceptional sales craft: thoughtful discovery, sharp positioning, executive presence and disciplined execution.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




  





 •
 **Win new enterprise accounts** 
 . Build and execute a focused acquisition strategy across banks, NBFCs and digital lenders.
 



  





 •
 **Build relationships across the buying committee** 
 . Engage CXOs and leaders across credit, risk, business, product, technology and procurement. Understand who champions, evaluates, approves and signs.
 



  





 •
 **Lead consultative sales conversations** 
 . Uncover the lender’s priorities and translate product capabilities into a credible business case around portfolio quality, underwriting efficiency and growth.
 



  





 •
 **Move evaluations towards commercial decisions** 
 . Work with internal teams to shape demonstrations, proposals and pilots with clear success criteria, decision owners and timelines.
 



  





 •
 **Own negotiations and closure** 
 . Navigate commercial discussions, procurement and contracting while protecting deal quality and long\-term relationship value.
 



  





 •
 **Run a disciplined pipeline** 
 . Maintain clear account plans, realistic forecasts and consistent follow\-through. Take accountability for revenue targets and account expansion.
 



  





 •
 **Bring the market into the business.** 
 Share buyer feedback, competitive insights and emerging needs to strengthen our positioning and product direction.
 



  





**Who we’re looking for** 




  





 • A proven enterprise sales professional with a strong track record of personally selling products or technology solutions to banks and NBFCs.
 



  





 •
 **A fintech background is strongly preferred** 
 , particularly in lending technology, credit analytics, risk intelligence, decisioning, banking software, financial data or API\-based products.
 



  





 • An established, active network of relevant decision\-makers across India’s lending ecosystem—and the ability to build credibility beyond existing relationships.
 



  





 • Demonstrated success managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluation and commercial negotiation.
 



  





 •
 **Exceptional executive presence** 
 : articulate in the room, precise in writing, confident in presentations and consistently professional in preparation and follow\-through.
 



  





 • Strong commercial judgment. You can qualify opportunities, build a compelling value proposition, handle objections and ask for the close.
 



  





 • The curiosity to understand a sophisticated product and explain its business value clearly to both technical and non\-technical buyers.
 



  





 • High ownership, sound judgment and the ability to create momentum independently.
 



  





**What will stand out** 




  





 Your ability to explain the deals you have personally won: the buyer, the problem, the complexity, your role and the commercial outcome.
 



  





 We value trusted relationships, thoughtful selling and a consistent record of delivery.
 



  





**Why join us** 




  





 • Sell technology addressing consequential problems in lending: credit risk, underwriting and access to credit.
 



 • Own important institutional relationships and directly influence enterprise growth.
 



 • Help shape how our products are positioned and adopted in the market.
 



 •
 **Earn above\-market compensation that reflects the experience and results you bring** 
 .
 



  





**Interested?** 




  





 Apply through LinkedIn or send a direct message with your profile and a brief overview of the products you’ve sold to lenders, the stakeholders you’ve worked with and two enterprise wins you personally led. Anonymised examples are welcome.
 



  





 If this sounds like someone in your network, we’d value an introduction.

title: Client Relationship Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 :Auraa Talents is a full\-time creative and model management agency representing Indian and international talent across the fashion and advertising industries. Established in 2008, the agency has collaborated with more than 1,000 brands and works with models from over 25 countries. Auraa Talents is known for showcasing India’s most diverse faces while maintaining strong global reach and industry connections. The agency emphasizes a safe and professional environment for young models, built on discipline, integrity, and ethical conduct. Team members join a collaborative setting that values creativity, respect, and long\-term partnerships.
 



  





**The Role:** 





 We're hiring a Client Relationship Executive to be the primary point of contact for our clients \- handling inbound and outbound calls, understanding what each client needs for their shoot or campaign, generating new business leads, and making sure every client's experience with us is a good one from first enquiry to post\-shoot feedback.
   






**What You'll Do:** 



* Call new and existing clients to understand their shoot/campaign requirements \- model type, budget, timeline, city, usage terms \- and translate that into a clear brief for the booking team.
* Proactively reach out to dormant or past clients to check in and generate repeat business.
* Own the client relationship end\-to\-end: keep them updated during the booking process, flag issues early, and be the person they call when something needs sorting out.
* Collect and log feedback after every shoot \- both what went well and what didn't \- and route it to the right internal team for action.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records of every client interaction, requirement, and outcome in our tracking sheets/CRM.
* Spot patterns worth escalating \- a client who's gone quiet, a recurring complaint, a brand that's ready for a bigger pitch.



**What We're Looking For:** 



* 2\-5 years in a client\-facing role \- inside sales, account management, client servicing, or a similarly phone\-heavy relationship role.
* Comfortable making a high volume of calls daily and confident having both easy and difficult conversations with clients.
* Strong spoken and written English and Hindi.
* Organized \- someone who logs everything and doesn't let a lead or a client go cold from lack of follow\-up.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and WhatsApp\-based client communication tools.
* A calm, solutions\-first attitude when handling complaints or last\-minute changes.

 Company Description:\- Demould is a fast\-growing bakery brand that began as a home\-based venture and now serves the wider Delhi\-NCR region with a central kitchen in Mayapuri, Gifting Studio in Kirti Nagar (Delhi Gifting Company) and a store in Rohini Sector 7\. Demould is driven by a strong passion for baking and a commitment to quality at every stage of production. The team focuses on delivering exceptional taste, innovative offerings, and appealing packaging, all centered around customer satisfaction. Applicants joining Demould will be part of a growing brand that values creativity, reliability, and consistent service excellence.
   

  

  

 Role:\- The Field Sales Executives role at Demould is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Delhi, India. This role is responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, including corporate clients, event planners, and institutional partners, to drive sales growth across the Delhi\-NCR region. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include building and maintaining client relationships, conducting market research, negotiating contracts, and creating proposals and presentations that reflect Demould’s product range and brand values. The Field Sales Executives will collaborate closely with the operations, marketing, and product teams to design promotional campaigns, plan seasonal offerings, and ensure that customer feedback informs business decisions. This role also involves monitoring performance metrics, preparing regular sales reports, and recommending strategies to expand market presence and enhance revenue.
   

  

  

 Detailed Description:\-
   

  

 Business Development – Generate leads through corporates, event/wedding planners, hotels, cafés, schools, hospitals, co\-working spaces, gifting companies, and luxury brands. Develop new sales channels for bakery products, premium gifting, customized hampers, desserts, and corporate solutions.
   

 Relationship Management – Build and maintain long\-term client relationships; negotiate terms and drive repeat business.
   

 Sales Ownership – Manage the end\-to\-end pipeline alongside the Sales Head, personally handle key accounts, and consistently exceed monthly/quarterly/annual targets.
   

 Strategic Planning – Plan ahead for festive and gifting seasons (Diwali, Christmas, Valentine's, weddings, etc.); create monthly action plans and sales calendars to maximize seasonal revenue.
   

 Marketing \& Brand – Liaise with marketing on updated collateral; represent Demould at trade shows, exhibitions, and networking events.
   

 Events \& Activations – Identify and execute pop\-ups, flea markets, corporate activations, and experiential events; evaluate ROI for future opportunities.
   

 CRM \& Reporting – Maintain lead records, submit weekly/monthly sales reports with insights, and track conversion ratios to refine the sales process.
   

 Cross\-functional Coordination – Partner with operations, production, design, kitchen, and gifting teams to ensure timely, high\-quality delivery.
   

  

  

 Key Metrics: Revenue targets, conversion ratios, seasonal campaign performance, team productivity, and client retention.
   

  

  

 Qualifications
   

  

 Minimum 1–3 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, or Corporate Sales.
   

 Experience in F\&B, Hospitality, Luxury Gifting, Events, Retail, or Corporate Sales will be preferred.
   

 Strong networking and relationship\-building abilities.
   

 Excellent negotiation and presentation skills.
   

 Leadership experience with the ability to manage and motivate a team.
   

 Highly organised with strong planning and execution skills.
   

 Comfortable with field sales, client meetings, and business travel across Delhi NCR.
   

 Self\-driven, target\-oriented, and capable of working independently.
   

 Familiarity with CRM software, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace and AI tools.

 .
   

  

 As a
 **Zoho Consulting Partner** 
 and winner of the
 **Zoho Developer Community Hackathon 2024** 
 , we combine consulting with strong technical execution to solve real operational problems for businesses in India and international markets.

 You will work closely with the founder, consultants, and technical team to connect with prospective customers, understand their business challenges, qualify opportunities, and move suitable prospects through the sales pipeline.
   

  

 This is a
 **consultative B2B technology sales role** 
 , not a script\-based telecalling position. The role requires someone who can research businesses, start meaningful conversations, understand customer requirements, follow up professionally, and develop long\-term relationships.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Research and identify potential B2B customers in target industries and markets.

* Comfortable speaking with business owners, managers, and senior decision\-makers.
* Ability to research companies and identify relevant sales opportunities.
* Good understanding of lead generation, prospecting, qualification, follow\-up, and sales pipelines.
* Ability to understand business processes and translate customer problems into solution requirements.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with CRM, email, LinkedIn, spreadsheets, and modern sales tools.
* Self\-motivated, organised, target\-oriented, and willing to take ownership of opportunities.

* Direct exposure to CRM, Zoho, automation, integrations, AI, SaaS, and custom software projects.

* Clear scope to grow into Senior Business Development, Account Management, Partnerships, or Solution Sales roles as the company grows.
* High degree of ownership and the opportunity to help build Digismiths' business\-development function from the ground up.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
**Apply here → https://forms.spurnow.com/sales\-hire** 




  





 Spur (https://spur.so) is an agentic CRM for businesses that sell to consumers over chat. 600\+ businesses across 50\+ countries run on Spur, around 5 million conversations a month: ecommerce brands first, and increasingly anyone whose customers message them on WhatsApp and Instagram, from real estate and travel to education, clinics and services. Every WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, email and live chat message lands in one inbox with AI handling most of it, and the same platform runs their campaigns, lead follow\-up, abandoned cart recovery and website conversion.
 



  





 We're bootstrapped and profitable. Zero external funding, zero marketing spend. Every customer we have today came from product quality, word of mouth, referrals and partnerships. We're 12 people: 2 founders, 3 engineers, 5 in customer success, 1 founding marketer, 1 sales lead.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 We have never had a BDR. Our sales lead closes more than 60% of the demos he takes, so everything after the demo is sorted. The gap is everything before it, and that's this seat.
 



  





 You'll own the outbound list: the brands and businesses we want on Spur, none of whom have heard of us yet. Most will be ecommerce, plenty will not be, and working out which is worth a call is part of the job. You research them, find the person who can say yes, call them, message them, follow up, and get them into a demo. You'll build the sequences and the automations that keep the list moving when you're not at your desk.
 



  





 This is a founding role in the real sense. There is no playbook to inherit, no manager above you running the process, and nobody to blame for a bad list. You write the playbook, and the first version of it will be wrong, which is fine as long as the second one is better.
 



  





**You'll probably be a fit if you** 




  




1. Have done outbound before and can tell us what your numbers were, including the months you missed
2. Build your own lists and your own tooling instead of waiting for someone to hand you either
3. Can talk to the founder of a brand or the owner of a business and sound like a peer, not a script
4. Use AI daily and have built something, even a no\-code automation, to kill a repetitive task
5. Write down what works, so the next person can run it without you in the room



  





**Bonus points** 




  




1. You've sold to Shopify or D2C brands, or worked at a Shopify app
2. You've done outbound into the UK, Europe, the Middle East or South America. Half our customers are outside India
3. You know the WhatsApp Business API world from the inside (ex\-BiteSpeed, AiSensy, Wati, Interakt, etc.)



  





**Logistics** 




  




1. Five days a week in our Green Park, Delhi office
2. You'll work with both founders, the sales lead who takes your demos, and the CS team who talk to customers all day
3. Appraisals every 12 months. Our motto: if Spur grows, the team should be the first to benefit



  





 How to apply
 



  





 Fill out our short application here → https://forms.spurnow.com/sales\-hire
 



  





 The form asks which role you're applying for, so one link covers both. We read every response, and you'll hear back either way.

 Pristine Water is an engineering company providing innovative water and wastewater treatment solutions to industrial, commercial, agricultural and institutional customers. Our solutions include electrochemical water and wastewater treatment systems, disinfection systems, water treatment and process solutions.
 



 We are looking for a Technical Sales Executive who can independently drive sales in an assigned geography—from identifying new opportunities and developing customer relationships to preparing and negotiating offers and closing orders.
 



**The Role** 




 This is a hands\-on individual contributor sales role. The person will be responsible for executing the company’s sales strategy in the assigned region and building a strong pipeline of new and repeat business.
 



 The ideal candidate will be someone who is comfortable selling technical/engineering systems, can understand customer requirements, identify upcoming projects, engage with multiple stakeholders and take an opportunity through the complete sales cycle.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Business Development \& New Customer Acquisition** 



* Identify and develop new customers and business opportunities within the assigned region.
* Prospect through direct outreach, market mapping, references, industry networks, exhibitions, consultants and other channels.
* Meet customers, understand their requirements and identify opportunities where Pristine Water’s solutions can add value.
* Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective customers and projects.



**Project \& Market Tracking** 



* Identify and track new industrial, infrastructure, commercial and other relevant projects coming up in the region.
* Develop relationships with consultants, EPC companies, contractors, OEMs, project developers and other relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor project timelines, decision\-makers, technical requirements and procurement processes.
* Ensure that Pristine Water is introduced and considered early in relevant projects.



**Technical Sales** 



* Understand customer requirements and work with the technical team to identify appropriate solutions.
* Discuss technical requirements and system configurations with customers and consultants.
* Prepare and present commercial and technical proposals in coordination with the internal team.
* Explain the benefits, applications and commercial value of Pristine Water’s solutions to customers.



**Sales Closure** 



* Follow up systematically on enquiries, proposals and active opportunities.
* Negotiate commercial terms and offers with customers within company guidelines.
* Manage the sales process from initial enquiry through technical discussions, commercial negotiations and purchase order.
* Take ownership of achieving sales targets and converting the assigned pipeline into orders.



**Customer Relationship Management** 



* Maintain regular contact with existing customers and develop long\-term relationships.
* Identify repeat business, upgrades, expansions and additional opportunities within existing accounts.
* Ensure that customer requirements and commitments are communicated effectively to the internal team.
* Maintain accurate records of customers, opportunities, project status and follow\-ups.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* 4–6 years of experience in sales, preferably in technical sales of engineering systems, industrial equipment, water/wastewater treatment systems, process equipment, electrical/mechanical systems, or similar products.
* Experience selling B2B technical or engineered solutions will be strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to independently develop new customers and close sales.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and have meaningful technical discussions with customers and consultants.
* Strong follow\-up and negotiation skills.
* Good understanding of the complete sales cycle—from lead generation to order closure.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region for customer and project meetings.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken, are essential.
* Should be confident interacting with customers, consultants, contractors and senior decision\-makers.
* Should be self\-driven, organized and comfortable working independently.



**Education** 




*Educational qualification is not a constraint.* 




 The candidate must have:
 


* Completed schooling, and
* A graduate\-level qualification, diploma or equivalent professional qualification.



 A strong track record in technical sales will be valued more highly than the specific academic discipline or institution.
 



**Who Will Succeed in This Role?** 




 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Is a hunter, not someone who waits for enquiries to come in.
* Enjoys meeting customers and developing relationships.
* Is comfortable understanding and selling technical products.
* Takes ownership of opportunities and follows them through to closure.
* Is persistent with follow\-ups without being overly aggressive.
* Can work independently and manage their own territory and pipeline.
* Is commercially minded and comfortable negotiating.
* Is curious about how engineering systems work and can learn new technologies quickly.
* Is accountable for results and sales numbers.



**What This Role Is Not** 




 This is
 *not a team\-management role* 
 . The position is for an individual contributor who will personally develop the market, manage customer relationships, track projects, build the sales pipeline and close business.
 



**Key Performance Indicators** 




 Success in this role will be measured through:
 


* New customers acquired
* Qualified sales pipeline developed
* New projects identified and converted
* Sales/orders achieved
* Conversion of enquiries and opportunities
* Repeat business from existing customers
* Customer and consultant relationships developed
* Timeliness and quality of opportunity follow\-up



 If you enjoy technical selling, building relationships and taking ownership of a territory from prospecting to closure, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Field Sales Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Aurassure is a climate intelligence company that helps governments, industries, and enterprises monitor and respond to environmental challenges using AI\-powered insights and hyperlocal data. Its integrated platform combines advanced IoT sensing, artificial intelligence, hyperlocal weather modeling, environmental analytics, and predictive forecasting to provide real\-time visibility into air quality, weather, heat stress, industrial emissions, flood risk, indoor environmental quality, and other climate parameters. Aurassure’s solutions support sectors such as Smart Cities, Manufacturing, Mining, Oil \& Gas, Construction, Transportation, Airports, Healthcare, Real Estate, Utilities, Education, and Climate Risk \& Insurance. With deployments in more than 350 cities across over 10 countries, the company processes billions of environmental data points to enable faster, data\-driven decisions. Aurassure is committed to using trusted data and climate intelligence to help organizations build safer, healthier, and more resilient communities while advancing global sustainability.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time Field Sales Engineer role based in New Delhi with a hybrid work arrangement, combining on\-site client engagement and limited work\-from\-home flexibility. The Field Sales Engineer will generate new business opportunities, manage the sales cycle, and support existing accounts by presenting Aurassure’s climate intelligence solutions to prospective and current clients. Daily responsibilities include conducting site visits and product demonstrations, understanding customer technical and operational needs, and proposing tailored solutions in collaboration with internal technical and product teams. The role also involves preparing proposals, coordinating pricing and negotiations, maintaining accurate sales and pipeline records, and ensuring timely follow\-up to drive conversions. The Field Sales Engineer will work closely with cross\-functional teams to support implementations, gather customer feedback, and contribute to market insights and sales strategy.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and Electrical Engineering skills to understand customer environments, interpret technical requirements, and translate Aurassure’s solutions into practical applications.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Sales Management skills to build pipelines, manage end\-to\-end sales cycles, and meet or exceed revenue and growth targets.
* Candidates should possess Account Management skills to maintain long\-term client relationships, support post\-sales engagement, and identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities.
* Relevant experience in climate tech, IoT, environmental monitoring, or related technology\-driven solutions is beneficial.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently in the field, manage travel within and around New Delhi, and collaborate effectively with remote and on\-site teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Sciences, or a related technical discipline is preferred; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Apply by commenting on this IG Reel → https://www.instagram.com/p/DdT8eV8zZ7w
 




  





 Spur (https://spur.so) is an agentic CRM for businesses that sell to consumers over chat. 600\+ businesses across 50\+ countries run on Spur, around 5 million conversations a month: ecommerce brands first, and increasingly anyone whose customers message them on WhatsApp and Instagram, from real estate and travel to education, clinics and services. Every WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, email and live chat message lands in one inbox with AI handling most of it, and the same platform runs their campaigns, lead follow\-up, abandoned cart recovery and website conversion.
 



  





 We're bootstrapped and profitable. Zero external funding, zero marketing spend. Every customer we have today came from product quality, word of mouth, referrals and partnerships. We're 12 people: 2 founders, 3 engineers, 5 in customer success, 1 founding marketer, 1 AE.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We have never had an SDR. New businesses sign up to Spur every single day, from D2C brands to real estate brokers and coaching institutes. Demo forms come in around the clock from India, the Gulf, Europe and the Americas. Our Instagram DMs fill up whenever the content does its job. Most of it goes cold, because nobody gets to it fast enough.
 



  





 That's this seat. You'll call the signups, the demo requests and the DMs, work out what they're actually trying to fix, and get them onto a demo. You'll call people who have already booked one to make sure they show up, because an AE sitting on an empty call is the most expensive thing we do. You'll call our own customers too: the ones who should be on an annual plan, the ones who have outgrown their tier, and the ones who are paying for Spur and using a tenth of it. And you'll build the automations that make next month faster than this one.
 



  





 This is a founding role in the real sense. There is no playbook to inherit and no manager above you running the process. You write it, and the first version will be wrong, which is fine as long as the second one is better.
 



  





**You'll probably be a fit if you** 



* Have worked inbound before and can tell us how many leads a day you handled and what share of them booked
* Get to a new lead in minutes, not tomorrow morning, and can explain how you made that possible
* Have moved a show\-up rate and know what actually did it
* Use AI daily and have built something, even a no\-code automation, to kill a repetitive task
* Write down what works, so the next person can run it without you in the room



  





**Bonus points** 



* You've sold to Shopify or D2C brands, or worked at a Shopify app
* You've called customers in the UK, Europe, the Middle East or South America. Half our customers are outside India
* You know the WhatsApp Business API world from the inside (ex\-BiteSpeed, AiSensy, Wati, Interakt, etc.)



  





**Logistics** 



* Five days a week in our Green Park, Delhi office
* You'll work with both founders, the AE who takes your demos, and the CS team who talk to customers all day
* Appraisals every 12 months. Our motto: if Spur grows, the team should be the first to benefit



  





**How to apply** 




 Apply by commenting on this IG Reel → https://www.instagram.com/p/DdT8eV8zZ7w
 



  





 The form asks which role you're applying for, so one link covers both. We read every response, and you'll hear back either way.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE
 



 At Buzz \| Atraski India
 



  





  





 ABOUT ATRASKI INDIA
 



  





 Atraski is a multi\-dimensional creative holding company powering a portfolio of consumer, B2B, and experiential brands. We operate at the intersection of strategy, creative excellence, and technology—building sustainable, scalable businesses across diverse verticals.
 



  





 Our verticals include:
 



 \- At Buzz: Digital marketing and creative agency (flagship vertical)
 



 \- Atraski Studios: Fashion marketing and creative production
 



 \- Atraski Experiences: Event management and experiential activation
 



 \- At Stay: Curated travel and hospitality experiences
 



 \- Jheeni: Heritage block\-printed sustainable fashion
 



 \- My City My Voice: Regional talent and community storytelling platform
 



 \- Atraski Tech Transformations (ATT): Digital transformation consulting
 



  





 ABOUT AT BUZZ
 



  





 At Buzz is our core creative agency focused on high\-growth D2C brands, B2B SaaS, FMCG, fashion, and EdTech clients. We deliver end\-to\-end solutions: brand strategy, performance marketing, content production, and media planning. Currently managing 39–45 active accounts with annual revenue in the ₹4–6 Cr range.
 



  





 We're looking for hungry, strategic Business Development leaders to drive our next phase of growth—moving from project\-based engagements to high\-value retainer partnerships.
 



  





 THE ROLE: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE
 



  





 As a Business Development Executive, you will own the full sales cycle for At Buzz—from prospect identification through deal closure and handoff to delivery teams. This is not an intern role; it is a professional, commission\-driven sales position for someone ready to own revenue impact.
 



  





 WHAT YOU'LL OWN
 



  





 1\. STRATEGIC MARKET RESEARCH \& LEAD GENERATION
 



 \- Profile and qualify high\-growth brands that match our core verticals (D2C, B2B SaaS, EdTech, FMCG, Fashion)
 



 \- Build a monthly prospect list of 50\+ targets using LinkedIn, industry databases, and proprietary research
 



 \- Prioritize warm outreach (referrals, mutual connections) and cold outreach (calling, email sequences)
 



 \- Track pipeline health in our CRM—maintaining a clean, real\-time sales funnel
 



  





 2\. SALES EXECUTION \& DEAL CLOSURE
 



 \- Execute 15–20 discovery calls/meetings per month to understand client pain points
 



 \- Develop tailored project briefs and ROI\-focused proposals aligned to each client's business objectives
 



 \- Own the negotiation process from initial scope to contract signature
 



 \- Close ₹15–30L\+ in new project/retainer value per quarter (based on experience level)
 



 \- Partner with creatives and strategists to build winning pitches
 



  





 3\. RELATIONSHIP BUILDING \& ACCOUNT STRATEGY
 



 \- Attend client meetings and site visits to build credibility and deepen relationships early
 



 \- Become a trusted strategic advisor—positioning At Buzz as a long\-term partner, not a vendor
 



 \- Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within the Atraski portfolio (Studios, Events, ATT)
 



 \- Maintain post\-sale relationships to drive renewals and referrals
 



  





 4\. CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION
 



 \- Conduct market and competitive intelligence to inform agency strategy
 



 \- Work closely with Operations, Delivery, and Finance to ensure smooth project handoffs
 



 \- Provide feedback from the market to guide service development and positioning
 



  





 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 CORE COMPETENCIES
 



  





 Sales\-Driven Mentality: You live for closing deals. You're energized by targets, competition, and hitting/exceeding quota.
 



  





 Strategic Thinking: You don't just sell—you understand why clients buy. You ask good questions, listen actively, and position solutions around real business outcomes.
 



  





 Relationship Builder: You genuinely enjoy people. You build trust quickly, follow up consistently, and turn prospects into long\-term advocates.
 



  





 Hustle \& Ownership: You're self\-motivated, action\-oriented, and comfortable with ambiguity. You own your pipeline and your results.
 



  





 Communication Excellence: You're articulate on calls, sharp in writing, and can tailor your message to C\-suite, marketing managers, and procurement teams alike.
 



  





 Digital Fluency: You're comfortable with LinkedIn, email sequences, CRM tools, spreadsheets, and can pick up new platforms quickly.
 



  





 EXPERIENCE PROFILE
 



  





 Option A (Mid\-Level – Preferred)
 



 \- 2–4 years in agency sales, B2B SaaS, or consulting sales
 



 \- Proven track record of closing ₹10–50L\+ annual contracts
 



 \- Experience selling professional services (creative, tech, or strategy)
 



 \- Comfortable with 40\-50% cold outreach
 



  





 Option B (Entry/Accelerated)
 



 \- 0–2 years of sales experience OR recent graduate with strong entrepreneurial track record
 



 \- Exceptional communication and grit (we can teach process)
 



 \- Willingness to learn CRM, sales fundamentals, and At Buzz's service offerings from day one
 



 \- Target\-driven mindset
 



  





  





 COMPENSATION \& INCENTIVES
 



  





 Base Salary: ₹3\.5–6\.5L annually (based on experience, interview performance)
 



  





 Performance Commission: 5–8% of first 12 months' retainer value per closed deal
 



  





 Quarterly Bonus: Up to ₹50k–2L if you exceed quarterly targets by 20%\+
 



  





 Benefits: Flexible work\-from\-home policy, professional development budget
 



  





 Example: Close a ₹20L annual retainer → ₹1–1\.6L commission (year 1\). Hit 120% of quarterly target → additional ₹50–100k bonus.
 



  





  





 WORK ENVIRONMENT
 



  





 Location: Chittaranjan Park, Greater Kailash, New Delhi
 



 Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM \+ Alternate Saturdays
 



 Reporting To: CEO
 



  





  





 WHY JOIN AT BUZZ?
 



  





 High\-Growth Trajectory: Join at a pivotal moment. At Buzz is scaling from project work to retainer partnerships—your deals define our trajectory.
 



  





 Uncapped Earning Potential: Base salary \+ performance commission means high performers take home ₹15–25L\+ in year 1–2\.
 



  





 Real Ownership: You own your numbers. No politics, no closed doors—direct accountability and direct reward.
 



  





 Quality Clients \& Work: Work with founders and CMOs at top D2C and B2B brands. See your deals turned into award\-winning work.
 



  





 Career Growth: Fast\-track to Head of BD, Client Success, or Strategy roles within 18–24 months.
 



  





 Agency Ecosystem: Access to creative talent, strategy expertise, and production capabilities across Atraski's verticals for pitches and delivery.
 



  





 APPLICATION \& NEXT STEPS
 



  





 TO APPLY:
 



 Submit resume \+ a 1\-page note on why you're interested in At Buzz
 



 Include 2–3 examples of deals you've helped close (or contributed to)
 



 Email to: anish.dhar@atraski.com and hr@atraski.com
 



  





 INTERVIEW PROCESS:
 



 Initial screening call (20 min) → Sales roleplay scenario (15 min) → Manager interview (45 min) → Final round with leadership
 



  





 TIMELINE:
 



 Decisions made within 2–3 business days of final interview.

 Chittaranjan Park, Greater Kailash, Delhi
 



 anish.dhar@atraski.com/hr@atraski.com

title: Mgr, Institution Sales
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.
   

  

 We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.
   

  

 This role will be responsible for driving growth of the Peritoneal Dialysis (PD) business through patient acquisition under PMJAY and other government\-funded healthcare schemes. The primary objectives are to increase new PD patient additions, develop strategic partnerships with PMJAY empaneled hospitals, and support sustainable expansion of PD.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Business Growth:
* Develop and execute business development strategies to drive new PD patient additions through PMJAY and other government funded reimbursement programs.
* Identify, map, and prioritize hospitals, nephrology centers, and government institutions with potential for PMJAY program implementation.
* Develop business cases and value propositions demonstrating clinical, operational, and economic benefits of PD adoption.
* Analyze market opportunity, patient flow, reimbursement dynamics, and competitive landscape to identify growth opportunities.
* Collaborate with Clinical, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and Commercial teams to develop PD expansion plans.
* Execution Excellence:
* Lead engagement with hospital management, nephrologists, dialysis departments, and procurement teams to establish new PD centers.
* Drive conversion of eligible CKD and dialysis patients to PD through structured stakeholder engagement.
* Facilitate operational readiness under PMJAY empanelment.
* Monitor patient acquisition, center activation, and utilization of metrics against defined targets.
* Support hospitals in navigating PMJAY processes, reimbursement requirements, and documentation.
* Maintain regular tracking of market developments, government initiatives, and policy changes affecting PD business.
* Cross Functional Collaboration:
* Partner with Sales, Clinical, and Marketing teams to execute territory growth strategies.
* Work closely with Market Access and Government Affairs teams to strengthen engagement with PMJAY and state health authorities.
* Collaborate with Finance, Supply Chain to ensure smooth implementation and support of PD programs.
* Coordinate with Medical Affairs, and clinical team to support capability building among hospital staff and healthcare professionals.
* Provide regular business updates, pipeline reviews, and growth opportunities to leadership.


**Education/Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Healthcare, or a related field.
* Around 7 to 10 years of experience in sales, business development, institutional business, market access, or healthcare program management.
* Experience in healthcare, medical devices, dialysis, renal care, or government\-funded healthcare programs will be preferred.

 Education

 We are looking for a Sr. Technical Support professional with experience in laboratory/life science instruments to support technical enquiries, instrument quotations, tenders/GeM activities, sales coordination, and post\-sales service requirements.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 • Provide technical and application support for laboratory and life science instruments.
   

  

 • Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable instruments, configurations, accessories, and related products.
   

  

 • Prepare technical\-commercial quotations, offers, and instrument proposals.
   

  

 • Handle tender and GeM activities, including technical documentation, OEM/supplier coordination, compliance documents, and bid submissions.
   

  

 • Coordinate with sales, service, application, procurement, logistics, suppliers, and customers for smooth execution of instrument orders.
   

  

 • Prepare Order Booking Forms and coordinate order processing, procurement, delivery, installation, and commissioning.
   

  

 • Handle quotations related to AMC/CMC, warranty, spare parts, accessories, and service requirements.
   

  

 • Maintain records of enquiries, quotations, tenders, orders, leads, and sales/service activities.
   

  

 • Support lead generation, customer follow\-ups, and sales/business development opportunities.
   

  

 • Monitor competitor activities, market requirements, and customer feedback related to laboratory instruments.
   

  

 Preferred Experience
   

  

 Experience with laboratory/life science instruments, such as:
   

  

 PCR / RT\-PCR \| Spectrophotometers \| Microplate Readers \| Centrifuges \| Gel Documentation Systems \| Electrophoresis Systems \| Cell Counters \| Imaging Systems \| Protein Analysis Instruments \| Laboratory Automation \| Bioreactors \| Other Research Instruments
   

  

 Eligibility
   

  

 • B.Sc / M.Sc / B.Tech / M.Tech in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or related fields.
   

  

 • Experience in technical support, application support, instrument sales support, customer support, or instrument commercial coordination.
   

  

 • Strong understanding of instrument specifications and applications.
   

  

 • Experience with quotations, tender/GeM documentation, and customer coordination will be preferred.
   

  

 • Good communication, documentation, follow\-up, and MS Excel skills.
   

  

 • Familiarity with CRM and sales reporting is an advantage.

 As per industry standards and candidate experience.

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in\-line cloud security platform.
   

  

 We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
   

  

**Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Sales Engineer, Enterprise to join our team. This is a Hybrid (Gurgaon) role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Sales Engineering in the SE India department. You will join a global group of professionals passionate about driving a secure, cloud\-enabled digital future as a leader in cloud security. You will demonstrate the power and agility of cloud transformation by aligning with regional leadership and engineering to deliver strategic solutions that solve complex customer challenges.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**
* Provide technical thought leadership and advice to enterprise customers on how to transform their digital experience
* Take total ownership of the technical sale and associated processes
* Identify and qualify technical opportunities while developing and maintaining trusted advisor relationships with key customer stakeholders
* Deliver impactful sales pitches, technical presentations, and whiteboards to ensure successful deployments


**Who You Are (Success Profile)**
* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution.
* You are a problem\-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser\-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high\-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**
* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI\-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* 15\+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or systems integrator
* Hands\-on experience in installing, configuring, and managing routers, switches, and network security technologies


**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Experience demonstrating or architecting enterprise cloud security platforms utilizing AI\-powered threat prevention, automated anomaly detection, or predictive data defense capabilities
* Proficiency with GPO, Active Directory/LDAP, and SSO/SAML protocols
* Deep understanding of HTTP, web security technologies (proxies, firewalls), and direct experience managing macOS, UNIX/Linux, and Windows systems


 At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
   

  

* Various health plans
* Time off plans for vacation and sick time
* Parental leave options
* Retirement options
* Education reimbursement
* In\-office perks, and more!


 Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.
   

  

 By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.
   

  

 Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Assistant Manager - Business Development & Pitch Support | Financial Services
description:
**About Interpath**
 Interpath is a leading independent advisory firm, supporting clients across complex business challenges and opportunities including M\&A, restructuring, transformation, transactions and performance improvement.
   

  

 Our Financial Services team is a growing practice with colleagues across the UK and India, supporting clients across a broad range of financial services sectors.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, we are looking for an
 **Assistant Manager \- Business Development \& Pitch Support** 
 to join our Financial Services team in Gurugram.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a
 **business development, research and pitch support role** 
 , aligned primarily to our Financial Services M\&A team and working closely with colleagues across Financial Services Debt Advisory and Loan Portfolio Due Diligence.
   

  

 You will work closely with Partners, Directors and Managers across the UK, supporting them in identifying opportunities, developing market insights and preparing high\-quality materials to help win new business.
   

  

 The role is
 **not a deal execution role** 
 . Instead, you will sit close to the front end of transactions and gain exposure to how opportunities are identified, researched and ultimately converted into client engagements.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What you will do**
**Pitch \& Business Development**
* Develop high\-quality, client\-facing pitch decks, credentials presentations, proposals and other business development materials
* Translate a Partner or Director's brief into clear, compelling and commercially relevant presentation material
* Support the preparation of proposals and RFP responses
* Maintain and develop the team's credentials and case study library
* Ensure high standards of presentation, formatting, accuracy and brand compliance


**Research \& Market Intelligence**
* Conduct company, sector and market research across financial services
* Develop sector maps, target lists, buyer/investor universes and market intelligence
* Research company ownership, shareholders, funding history, transaction history and relevant market activity
* Track M\&A and broader financial services market developments
* Turn research and data into concise, actionable insights that can support client conversations and business development


**Thought Leadership**
* Support the development of financial services thought leadership, market reports, sector insights and points of view
* Research emerging trends and themes across financial services and translate them into meaningful client\-facing content
* Help develop compelling narratives and insights rather than simply presenting data


**Pipeline \& Stakeholder Management**
* Maintain accurate business development and opportunity pipeline information
* Prepare materials for pipeline and business development meetings
* Track actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders
* Work directly with senior stakeholders across London, Manchester and Leeds
* Manage multiple requests and deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail


 What we're looking for
   

  

 We are looking for someone who combines
 **strong research capability, excellent PowerPoint skills and commercial thinking** 
 .
   

  

**Essential Experience**
* Relevant experience in business development, pitch support, research, strategy, investment banking, corporate finance, transaction advisory or a similar professional services environment
* Demonstrable experience creating high\-quality client\-facing pitch decks, presentations, proposals or credentials materials
* Experience contributing to thought leadership, industry reports, market insights, white papers or similar content
* Strong experience in company, market and sector research and the ability to turn research into meaningful insights
* Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills
* Excellent written and verbal English
* Ability to work with senior stakeholders and manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines
* Willingness to work with UK\-based teams and maintain a daily overlap with UK business hours


**Desirable**
* Experience within the Financial Services sector, including banking, insurance, asset \& wealth management, fintech, payments, specialty lending or related areas
* Exposure to M\&A, Debt Advisory, transaction services or other deal\-related environments
* Experience working with international stakeholders across different locations and time zones
* Familiarity with market and financial databases such as Capital IQ, PitchBook, Bloomberg, Refinitiv, Mergermarket or similar platforms
* CFA, MBA, CA or another relevant professional qualification


 What will make you successful?
   

  

 We are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate three things:
   

  

* Pitch Decks You can take a brief from a senior stakeholder and turn it into a polished, compelling and client\-ready presentation
* Thought Leadership You can understand a market or industry theme, develop a point of view and communicate it through high\-quality written and visual content
* Research You can go beyond collecting information — you can identify what matters, interpret the findings and turn them into insights that support a commercial conversation


 You should be comfortable asking,
 **"What is the question we're really trying to answer?"** 
 and
 **"So what does this mean for the client or the business?"**
 Why join us?
   

  

 This is an opportunity to work closely with senior Financial Services professionals across the UK and gain exposure to the
 **origination side of M\&A and advisory work** 
 .
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to develop your understanding of financial services markets, contribute to high\-profile pitches and thought leadership, and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our Financial Services practice.
   

  

**If you are someone who enjoys research, storytelling, creating impactful presentations and working closely with senior stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you.**
**Our Values:**
**Embrace different: \-** 
 From cultures to mindsets, we welcome them all. Our global presence means we're inclusive by nature and we believe that people are equal, but not the same.
   

  

**Do the right thing:** 
 \- Our comfort zone is uncomfortable; we always make the right decision not what is simply easy or popular. Always consider how to implement these decisions, people will always remember how you made them feel.
   

  

**All hands on deck:** 
 \- We stand shoulder to shoulder with colleagues and clients, be that physically or from afar. Our individual expertise may find them answers, but it is through teamwork that it is implemented.
   

  

**Passion drives success:** 
 \- The impossible is always possible, we push the boundaries of what is expected because we're never satisfied with the status quo. Our clients expect a positive result when they engage with us, and it's only by delivering this that we win.
   

  

**Benefits**
****Benefits****
* Opportunity to grow within a fast\-paced global organisation and build deep expertise in M\&A integration
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and executive management
* Competitive salary package, aligned with experience and market standards
* International exposure, working with multicultural teams across multiple regions

title: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 As a Strategic Account Executive for India, you’ll be one of the foundational members of SpaceXAI’s enterprise sales team in the region. You’ll help large engineering organizations discover, adopt, and expand their use of Cursor, owning strategic accounts across APJ and working directly with engineering leaders, CTOs, developer platform teams, and procurement stakeholders.
   

  

 This is a rare opportunity to bring a product engineers already love into some of India's most sophisticated technology, financial services, enterprise, and digital\-native organizations and to help shape how software gets built in the AI era.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Own a named book of strategic enterprise accounts across India, driving new logo acquisition and expansion revenue
* Run a disciplined, full\-cycle sales process from prospecting and discovery through evaluation, negotiation, and close
* Build and execute account strategies that connect Cursor’s capabilities to the technical and business priorities of engineering leaders, CTOs, and developer platform teams
* Create pipeline through outbound prospecting, executive mapping, inbound follow\-up, partner referrals, and your own network
* Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver high\-quality evaluations and ensure customers realize value quickly
* Navigate complex enterprise buying processes, including security reviews, legal negotiations, procurement, and multi\-stakeholder approval cycles
* Serve as the voice of India's enterprise customers internally, sharing market feedback and deal learnings with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and GTM leadership
* Help establish SpaceXAI’s enterprise presence in India by building repeatable motions, local market insights, and early customer references
* Consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets


**You may be a fit if**
* You have 5\+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, ideally selling developer tools, infrastructure, cloud, security, AI, or other technical SaaS products to engineering\-led organizations
* You have experience selling into strategic or large enterprise accounts in India
* You’re comfortable navigating complex buying committees across engineering, IT, security, legal, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders
* You’re a true hunter: you proactively build pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, creative sourcing, executive engagement, and persistent follow\-up
* You have strong command of pipeline management, account planning, and forecasting across a strategic book of business
* You’re energized by technical products and can hold credible conversations with senior engineers, platform leaders, and CTOs about how Cursor fits into modern development workflows
* You’re a self\-starter who thrives in an early\-stage, resource\-constrained environment and can build process, playbooks, and regional learnings as you go
* You care deeply about AI and believe transforming how software is written is one of the most important problems to work on right now

Jomotel blends modern comfort with natural surroundings to create distinctive accommodations for contemporary travelers. Founded by Kartik Gupta and Avinash Sharma, the brand was created with a vision to offer quality services in alternative accommodation. Team members join a growing organization that values guest\-centric service, reliability, and innovation in hospitality.

title: Restaurant POS Sales Executive
description:
**About QuickKOT** 




 QuickKOT is a cloud based POS for restaurants in India. A café starts free on Basic — kitchen tickets, GST bills, cash / card / UPI in the browser, no demo and no install. The same tickets scale to food courts and hotels that need one guest bill and many kitchens, and to chains that need distinct tills (tickets never cross cities).
 



 We are hiring a salesperson in Delhi/NCR who already knows how restaurant POS is sold — not someone who will learn hospitality from a slide deck.
 



  





**The role** 




 You own the pipeline from first conversation to a live restaurant on QuickKOT. You sell the product on the floor: café counters, mall food courts, hotel F\&B, and multi\-outlet brands in and around Delhi NCR, plus remote closes anywhere in India.
 



 You report to the founder. You work from home. When a court or hotel wants a walk\-through, you go.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Build and run a restaurant POS pipeline: cafés, QSR, dhabas, canteens, food courts, hotel F\&B, cloud kitchens and chains.
* Qualify the floor: one kitchen vs many kitchens on one bill vs separate restaurants (that distinction matters here).
* Run demos on the live product (signup is self\-serve; you still walk the manager through KOT, GST bill, kitchen display, token pickup, and reports).
* Close Economy / Premium / Enterprise and help Basic houses start so they can grow.
* Keep a clean CRM: next step, decision\-maker, kitchens, billing model, go\-live date.
* Hand a signed house to onboarding without inventing features we do not ship.
* Feed product with what the floor actually asked for — not a feature wishlist from a competitor’s brochure.



  





**Must have** 



* Prior 2\-4 years’ experience selling restaurant POS / billing / KOT software in India (not generic SaaS, not only printers or payment terminals).
* Based in Delhi / NCR; able to work remotely and visit accounts in the region.
* Comfort talking to owners, F\&B managers, and mall / hotel operations — in Hindi and English.
* Ability to explain GST bills, kitchen tickets, and “one bill, many kitchens” without a script.
* Own laptop, reliable internet, and a phone you will actually pick up during service hours.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Book of restaurants, food courts, or hotel groups in NCR you can reopen (no poaching of confidential lists).
* Food\-court / hotel F\&B deals, not only single\-outlet cafés.
* Experience with a self\-serve or product\-led POS (they can start without you; you still close the paid floor).



  





**What this is not** 



* Not inside sales only, never leaving the desk.
* Not a partner / affiliate role.
* Not hardware sales (printers, drawers) as the main job.
* Not “sell India plus overseas.” QuickKOT plans are billed in Indian rupees.

title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 Our partners \- card networks, banks, airlines, travel platforms, fintechs \- are mostly many times our size. The job is to get a decision\-maker to take the call, then build a construct that works commercially for both sides.
   

  

 The second part is the hard part. A visa is a low\-frequency purchase. A partnership only works if you find the moment in the partner's own customer journey where we belong, and structure the economics so they have a reason to care.
 **There's no playbook.**
**The Role**
 Most companies handle business\-travel visas badly — an office manager or travel desk stitching together agents and embassy appointments, nobody owning it until something breaks three days before a flight.
 **Atlys for Business fixes that.**
 The bar is
 **30 new accounts live every month.**
 You won't dial blind. We process visas for over a million travellers, so we already know which companies send people abroad on business. That's your list. The job is working it in the right order.
   

  

 You source, pitch, close and onboard. Ops and support take the day\-to\-day after that; you keep the commercial relationship and grow it.
   

  

**The Job**
* Convert 30 new organisations into active Atlys for Business customers every month.
* Make 50\+ calls a day, alongside email and LinkedIn outreach. The volume isn't optional.
* Run high\-volume demos and keep your calendar consistently filled.
* Adapt your pitch to every prospect \- a travel desk at a 5,000\-person manufacturer and an EA at a 200\-person startup need different conversations.
* Own onboarding through the first transaction \- signed but never booked isn't closed.
* Maintain a disciplined, transparent pipeline with clear next steps and no surprises.
* Grow commercial relationships with customers after they go live.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 2–3 years of sales experience, minimum. This is a hard bar.
* Have no degree or institution filter \- what you've done matters more than where you studied.
* Have real phone stamina and are comfortable maintaining a high\-volume calling motion every day.
* Know how to prioritise a large prospect universe: which 50 of 500 companies to work first, and why.
* Have strong commercial judgement and understand what a deal is worth and what it costs to serve.
* Are highly organised and disciplined about pipeline management, follow\-ups and execution.
* Communicate exceptionally well in both verbal and written communication.
* Are comfortable adapting your pitch and approach based on the person, organisation and context.
* Take strong ownership from first outreach through closing and first transaction.


*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*
