The role owns the full sales cycle — prospecting, pipeline building, solution pitching, commercial negotiation and closure — and continues as the client's trusted point of contact to drive retention, renewals and account expansion.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**New Business Development (NBD) \& Revenue Growth** 



* Own and exceed ambitious quarterly and annual revenue targets for ESG SaaS subscriptions, GHG accounting tools, CBAM solutions and ESG reporting/advisory services.
* Build a robust, self\-generated pipeline through outbound prospecting, industry networks, events, conferences, partnerships and inbound qualification across India, EU, US and Middle East markets.
* Identify and convert high\-potential segments: BRSR\-mandated listed companies, EU\-exporting manufacturers exposed to CBAM (steel, aluminium, cement, fertilizers, hydrogen, electricity), CSRD\-covered entities, and supply\-chain partners of global brands.
* Lead the complete sales cycle — discovery, product demonstrations, solution mapping, proposal and RFP responses, commercial negotiation and contract closure.
* Consistently maintain healthy win rates, deal velocity and average deal sizes; keep CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting at all times.



**Solution \& Consultative Selling** 



* Translate client sustainability and compliance needs (GHG inventory, CBAM reports, BRSR/CSRD/GRI/CDP disclosures, decarbonisation roadmaps) into tailored EcoMS platform and service propositions.
* Deliver compelling product demos and executive presentations to CXOs, CSOs, CFOs, EHS and sustainability heads.
* Structure commercial models — SaaS licensing, multi\-year subscriptions, managed services and advisory retainers — that maximise contract value and client fit.



**Client Servicing \& Account Growth** 



* Act as the primary relationship owner post\-sale; ensure smooth onboarding hand\-off and high client satisfaction.
* Drive renewals, upsell and cross\-sell (additional modules, geographies, entities, advisory add\-ons) to grow net revenue retention.
* Resolve client escalations promptly in coordination with delivery, product and support teams.



**Market Intelligence \& Collaboration** 



* Track ESG regulatory developments (CBAM phases, CSRD/ESRS timelines, BRSR Core, ISSB adoption) and competitor moves; feed insights into product and pricing strategy.
* Represent EcoMS at industry forums, exhibitions and webinars to build brand visibility and generate leads.
* Work closely with marketing on campaigns, collateral and lead\-generation programs; mentor junior BD team members as the team scales.



**Candidate Profile — Must\-Have** 



* **6–10 years of B2B sales experience,** 
 with a significant majority in selling ESG/sustainability SaaS platforms, GHG accounting tools, CBAM solutions, ESG reporting software or allied sustainability services.
* **Proven hunter with a large new\-clientele track record —** 
 documented history of acquiring substantial new logo bases and building territories/verticals from scratch.
* **Big numbers, verifiable sales record —** 
 consistent achievement/overachievement of large revenue quotas; ability to demonstrate closed ARR/TCV figures, win rates and ramp performance.
* **Strong NBD and closure skills —** 
 end\-to\-end ownership from cold outreach to signed contract; skilled negotiator comfortable with enterprise procurement and legal cycles.
* **Excellent client servicing orientation —** 
 record of high renewal rates, account expansion and long\-standing client relationships.
* **Domain fluency —** 
 working knowledge of GHG Protocol (Scope 1/2/3\), CBAM mechanics, BRSR, GRI, CSRD/ESRS, CDP, TCFD/ISSB and the broader ESG compliance landscape.
* **Global market exposure —** 
 experience selling to or engaging clients in at least one international market (EU, US or Middle East) in addition to India; comfort with cross\-time\-zone engagement.
* Excellent communication, presentation and executive\-engagement skills; proficiency with CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot/Zoho) and modern sales tooling.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA (Sales/Marketing) or sustainability\-related qualification preferred.

**Desirable** 



* Existing network of sustainability, EHS and CXO decision\-makers across manufacturing, energy, textiles, chemicals, metals, FMCG, BFSI or IT/ITES.

* Prior experience in a start\-up/scale\-up environment with a builder's mindset.



**Key Performance Indicators** 



* New ARR / revenue booked vs. target (quarterly and annual).
* Number and quality of new logos acquired; pipeline coverage (3–4x of quota).
* Win rate, average deal size and sales\-cycle length.
* Renewal rate, net revenue retention and upsell/cross\-sell revenue from owned accounts.
* Client satisfaction (NPS/CSAT) for accounts under management.



**What We Offer** 



* Front\-row seat in one of the fastest\-growing regulatory\-driven markets globally (ESG, CBAM, climate disclosure).

* Global exposure across India, EU, US and Middle East markets.
* High\-ownership role with a clear path to leadership as the BD function scales.

 Share your resume along with a brief note on your ESG/sustainability sales track record (targets vs. achievement, key logos won, deal sizes) at jobs@ecomsww.com with the subject line “Application – Senior Manager BD (ESG SaaS)”.

**Company Description** 
 VAI Technologies is an Opthalmology\-focused AI startup building clinical decision support tools for corneal and refractive care.
 
 Our flagship product, Kera AI, uses AI\-driven corneal analysis to support keratoconus detection and refractive surgery planning \- helping surgeons to make faster, safer, and more consistent decisions across the surgical pathway. We work closely with corneal and refractive surgeons across India and are scaling adoption in leading eye hospitals and surgical chains.
 




  





**Role Description** 
 We are hiring a Senior Manager Sales Business Development role to lead field sales and clinical partnerships for our Surgery Decision Support platform for refractive surgeries.
 
 This is a high\-ownership, revenue\-facing role for someone who already speaks the language of cornea and refractive workflows, and who can walk into a hospital and have a credible, peer\-level conversation with a cataract/refractive surgeon or a hospital's clinical/procurement leadership.
 





 You will own the sales pipeline end\-to\-end \- from opening doors with ophthalmologists and hospital decision\-makers, to running clinical demonstrations, to closing and expanding accounts \- while working closely with the founding team on positioning, pricing, and go\-to\-market strategy.
 




  





**Roles and Responsibilites** 



* Build and run the national sales pipeline for Kera AI's surgery decision support offering across corneal/refractive surgery centers, multi\-specialty eye hospital chains, and individual surgeon practices.
* Lead the full sales cycle: prospecting, clinical demos, surgeon and hospital stakeholder management, commercial negotiation, and closing.
* Leverage existing relationships with ophthalmologists, refractive surgeons, and hospital administrators/ procurement heads to accelerate access and shorten sales cycles.
* Represent Visionary AI at ophthalmology conferences, CMEs, and clinical events (e.g. AIOS, state ophthalmological society meets, etc.) to build visibility and pipeline.
* Articulate Kera AI's clinical and workflow differentiation built on top of data from established devices such as Pentacam (Oculus) and other Scheimpflug/topography\-based systems, in conversations with clinically sophisticated buyers.
* Partner with the founding/clinical team to tailor positioning, pricing, and deployment models (capex, subscription, per\-scan, etc.) by account type.
* Gather structured field feedback from surgeons on clinical workflow fit, and feed it back into product and clinical evidence priorities.
* Track and report pipeline, conversion, and revenue metrics; forecast accurately for a seed\-stage, fast\-iterating environment.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Prior sales/BD experience selling into ophthalmology — ideally corneal, refractive, or cataract surgery\-adjacent capital equipment, diagnostics, or software.
* Direct experience selling, supporting, or working alongside Pentacam (Oculus) or a competing corneal topography / tomography system (e.g. Sirius, Galilei, Orbscan, MS\-39, Cassia) is strongly preferred.
* An existing, active network of ophthalmologists, refractive surgeons, and eye hospital decision\-makers across India.
* Comfort selling a clinical AI / software product to a technically sharp audience — able to discuss topography metrics, staging systems (e.g. Belin ABCD), and surgical decision workflows credibly.
* Track record of carrying and consistently meeting/exceeding a sales quota in a med\-tech, diagnostics, or healthcare AI environment.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India to meet surgeons and hospital leadership in person.
* Startup mindset — comfortable with ambiguity, wearing multiple hats, and building process rather than inheriting it.

description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




 · Support principal\-led origination into hyperscalers, sovereign and AI\-native model operators, GCC and Global\-2000 occupiers and credible operator\-partners: build and maintain target lists, research decision\-makers, prepare briefing packs and site packages, and run disciplined follow\-up so that no thread goes cold
 



 · Prospect actively and generate first meetings through self\-directed outreach rather than waiting for inbound enquiry, and report a weekly count of new conversations opened and requirements captured
 



 · Hold and progress working\-level technical\-commercial conversations on the shell\-and\-core proposition: power availability and density, cooling readiness, fibre routes, latency to points of presence, proximity to subsea cable landings and internet exchanges, and delivery timelines
 



 · Capture each customer requirement to a standard template (day\-one MW and expansion rights, redundancy and tier expectation, connectivity and latency thresholds, state preference, lease versus purchase stance, target delivery date), observing the platform’s listen\-first rule: understand the requirement, never broadcast our plans
 



 · Translate land, power and cost evidence into customer\-ready and investor\-ready collateral with the land, power and finance teams: title and possession status, grid connectivity stage (CTU, STU and GNA application status, sanctioned versus applied\-for capacity, voltage level), indicative tariff and delivery date, presented as teasers, site one\-pagers and question responses
 



 · Own pipeline, CRM and data room hygiene: every opportunity, requirement, next action, owner and dated status kept current, with the underlying evidence file for each site version\-controlled and ready for a counterparty’s diligence team
 



 · Support the conversion of conversations into paper: prepare requirement summaries and first drafts of letters of intent, heads of terms and take\-or\-pay pre\-commitment documents for principal and counsel review, and track what each counterparty (and our lenders) must see before signing
 



 · Monitor state data centre and IT/ITeS policies, incentive frameworks, competitor activity and announced hyperscaler and operator commitments across the target states, and produce a written monthly read\-out for leadership
 



 Skills Required
 



**Experience and Qualification** 




 · 3–6 years of experience in a technical\-commercial, business development, pre\-sales, consulting or infrastructure\-advisory role, gained in at least one directly adjacent domain: data centres or colocation, power generation, transmission or grid, cloud or AI compute infrastructure, telecom and fibre networks, or industrial and logistics real estate. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or a technology discipline is required; an IIT or NIT background is welcomed
 



 · Working command of data centre fundamentals sufficient to hold an unsupervised conversation with a customer’s infrastructure team: what a MW of IT load means commercially, rack power density and the direction it is moving, air versus liquid cooling and what liquid\-cooling readiness requires of a shell, PUE, redundancy and tier expectations, floor loading and MW per acre, and why secured power rather than land is the binding constraint on delivery
 



 · Literacy in AI\-driven demand: why training and inference workloads impose different power density, cooling and latency profiles from traditional enterprise IT, how that reshapes what an occupier asks a developer for, and who buys that capacity in India across hyperscalers, sovereign and AI\-native model operators and GCC and Global\-2000 enterprises
 



 · Grid literacy: the difference between indicated, applied\-for and sanctioned capacity, what document evidences each, what a connectivity or general network access application involves and how long it runs, and why a customer’s diligence team tests sanctioned capacity and the committed drawl date rather than a developer’s stated position
 



 · Demonstrable hunting instinct and sales drive, evidenced by self\-generated outreach that converted into meetings and moved opportunities forward from a cold start, together with comfort operating around an asset still being assembled (land under acquisition, grid applications in process, tariff and delivery date indicative rather than fixed). This is not an order\-taking role and there is no completed facility or rate card to sell from
 



 · Excellent written English and rigorous document, pipeline and CRM discipline, with the reliability to own the detail behind a principal’s relationship; fluency in English and Hindi; willingness to travel across India at short notice and internationally as required

description:
**About this role:**
 Our Business Development teams play a critical role in expanding Gartner’s presence across the global market. Gartner Business Development Executives strategically acquire new clients by cultivating trust\-based relationships with C\-level executives to understand their mission critical priorities and uncover opportunities to deliver client\-value through the lens of the industry in which they operate. Gartner Business Developers drive the full sales cycle, from identifying prospects to closure and transition of new accounts to the account management team.
   

  

**About Gartner Midsize Enterprise (MSE):**
 MSE represents one of Gartner’s largest sales populations across the US, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific. This high\-growth sales organization acquires and supports our High Tech and End User client accounts with annual revenue targets between $10 million and $1 billion per year.
   

  

**Understanding The Work Environment \& Standards Across MSE:**
 Gartner MSE operates in a hybrid work environment. This means working virtually and in the office. We have in\-office experiences which can be as often as several times each week like 1:1’s with your manager, team meetings, and upskilling sessions. Coming together with colleagues in our Gartner office is a great way to build relationships across the business while collaborating, learning, and growing together.
   

  

 At Gartner MSE, our sales associates play a key role in partnering with C\-Level executives. We believe a professional appearance and workspace play a big part in building trust and credibility. As such, we maintain a business casual dress code.
   

  

**What you will do:**
 Business Development Executives will be given a territory of Midsize Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. Other role highlights include:
   

  

* Build trust\-based value\-added relationships with C\-Level prospects to quickly uncover the mission critical priorities and determine how Gartner can support success.
* Drive high\-quality activity to build pipeline with multi\-touch prospecting outreach and campaigns.
* Convert viable prospects into active Gartner clients, owning the full sales conversation and negotiation, through to the transition of new clients to the account management team.
* Conduct calls with C\-Level prospects to qualify, showcase capabilities and close the business.
* Partner with internal partners across the business to bring Gartner to life through portal walkthroughs and proof of concepts.
* Transition new accounts to account management to ensure a fast start to new client value.
* Deliver against assigned annual quota for your territory.


**What you will need:**
* 4\+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments.
* Experience selling to and/or influencing C\-Level Executives.
* Proven track record meeting and exceeding sales targets.
* Proven ability to precisely manage and forecast a complex sale process.
* Willingness to live within a commutable distance to the location required for this role.
* Relocation assistance is available for qualifying candidates.
* Bachelor's degree desired


**What you will get:**
* We'll invest in you. At Gartner, you'll get more than just a job. You'll get everything you need to build an exciting, rewarding career.
* Career growth starts here. Take your growth into your own hands by tapping into individual development plans, mentorships, and career progression opportunities.
* Uncapped earnings potential. Our sellers' success is recognized and rewarded accordingly.
* Comprehensive onboarding. All new hires begin their time at Gartner by going through Expedition, a robust training program to help them succeed.
* Rewards and recognition. Annual "Winners Circle" event, an all\-expense paid trip for our top performers each year.
* Consistent quarter over quarter growth. Gartner is purposefully built to adjust, adapt and pivot our strategy when macro\-environmental shifts occur.


**Who are we?**
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
   

  

 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
   

  

**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
 Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
   

  

 We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
   

  

 Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
   

  

 We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
   

  

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
 At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
   

  

 It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
   

  

**What do we offer?**
 Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
   

  

 In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
   

  

 Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Sales & Business Development Intern
description:
Modelens is looking for a proactive, driven and entrepreneurial person to join our sales team and help bring new business to the company.
   

  

 This is a pure sales and business development role where your primary responsibility will be to identify potential clients, reach out to them, pitch Modelens, build relationships and convert opportunities into paying business.
   

  

 You’ll work across online and offline sales, with clear targets and performance\-linked profit sharing.
   

  

**ROLE DETAILS**
 Role: Sales \& Business Development Intern
   

 Duration: 3 months
   

 Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid
   

 Eligibility: Current college students \& freshers
   

  

**ABOUT MODELENS**
 Modelens is a creative production platform that connects brands with models, creators, photographers and other creative professionals through curated talent and end\-to\-end production.
   

  

 We help brands discover the right talent and get their creative work executed end\-to\-end as per their requirements, budget and timelines.
   

  

 As an early\-stage, founder\-led business, every new client directly contributes to our growth. Our sales team plays a key role in making that happen.
   

  

**WHAT YOU’LL OWN**
* Identify potential B2B clients, brands, agencies and businesses for Modelens.
* Reach out to prospects through LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email, calls, networking and offline meetings.
* Initiate conversations and understand potential clients' requirements.
* Pitch Modelens and communicate our services and value proposition effectively.
* Schedule and participate in client meetings and sales conversations.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and move opportunities towards closure.
* Convert leads into paying Modelens clients.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships to generate repeat business and referrals.
* Maintain a structured sales pipeline from lead → conversation → meeting → proposal → negotiation → closure.
* Research new industries, businesses and potential customer segments.
* Work towards defined weekly and monthly sales targets.
* Track outreach, meetings, leads, conversions and revenue generated.
* Experiment with different approaches to improve lead generation and conversion.
* Work directly with the Founder on high\-value prospects and sales opportunities.


**TARGETS \& PERFORMANCE**
 This is a target\-driven role. You will work towards measurable goals around:
   

* Prospects reached
* Conversations initiated
* Meetings booked
* Qualified leads generated
* Clients acquired
* Revenue generated


 Performance will be evaluated based on actual business outcomes and conversions, not simply the number of messages or calls made.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
* Currently pursuing college or a recent graduate.
* Genuinely interested in sales, business development, startups and entrepreneurship.
* Comfortable with cold outreach, calls, networking, pitching and rejection.
* Confident communicating with business owners, founders and decision\-makers.
* Proactive and willing to take initiative without waiting for instructions.
* Target\-oriented and motivated by results.
* Persistent with follow\-ups and comfortable chasing opportunities.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills.
* Curious, resourceful and quick to learn.
* Able to work independently in an early\-stage startup environment.
* More focused on generating business than simply completing tasks.


**PERKS \& OPPORTUNITIES**
* Direct access and mentorship from the Founder.
* Hands\-on experience in B2B sales and client acquisition.
* Exposure to the creative production and startup ecosystem.
* Ownership of the complete sales cycle.
* Performance\-linked profit sharing on successful business generated.
* Internship certificate.
* Performance recognition / recommendation for strong performers.
* Modelens goodies and other team perks.
* Opportunity to continue with Modelens based on performance and business requirements.


**THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF…**
 You see a brand and immediately think, “How can we get them as a Modelens client?”
   

  

 You enjoy talking to people, finding opportunities, pitching ideas, following up and closing deals and generating revenue. You’re comfortable hearing “no,” learning from it and trying again.
   

  

 If you want a conventional internship where you’re simply assigned tasks, this may not be the role for you.
   

  

 If you want to actually learn sales by selling, work directly with a Founder and see your efforts translate into clients and revenue, you’ll fit right in.

description:

You will collaborate directly with business owners to gather requirements, translate operational needs into clear User Stories, oversee developer implementation, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and ensure end\-to\-end delivery of high\-impact Salesforce solutions.

**1\. Discovery \& Business Consultation** 



* **Requirement Gathering:** 
 Partner directly with business owners and Sales Leadership to capture business goals, operational pain points, and functional requirements.
* **Solution Brainstorming:** 
 Lead consultative brainstorming sessions to evaluate existing Sales Cloud and Dealhub CPQ capabilities, designing efficient, scalable business processes.
* **Process Mapping:** 
 Map end\-to\-end business workflows, quote\-to\-cash processes, approval logic, and pipeline management structures.



**2\. Requirements Translation \& Agile Management** 



* **User Story Creation:** 
 Translate business requirements into detailed functional specs, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria within Jira.
* **Sprint Collaboration:** 
 Brief development teams, clarify functional details, and assist in technical estimation and sprint planning.



**3\. Solution Delivery \& Developer Management** 



* **Hands\-On Functional Configuration:** 
 Configure core Sales Cloud features and Dealhub CPQ rules..
* **Developer Coordination:** 
 Coordinate with Dev team for all development works related to the user stories created and make sure to have timely checks in place.
* **Project Oversight:** 
 Drive delivery momentum, ensuring developers stick to project timelines, quality standards, and acceptance criteria.



**4\. Testing, UAT \& Stakeholder Deployment** 



* **UAT Orchestration:** 
 Design test scenarios, author test scripts, and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) sessions with business stakeholders.
* **Stakeholder Sign\-Off:** 
 Track defect resolution, collect formal stakeholder approval, and manage change management/end\-user enablement before go\-live.

* **Salesforce Expertise:** 
 3–6 years of functional experience as a Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst, with deep hands\-on expertise in Sales Cloud.

 Solid functional understanding of Dealhub CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) architecture, including Product \& Price Rules, Approval Workflows, and Quote Templates.

 Proven experience running discovery workshops, writing user stories with clear acceptance criteria, and working within Agile/Scrum frameworks.

 Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills to align non\-technical business leaders with technical development teams.

 Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM\-201\), Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant, or Salesforce CPQ Specialist.

 While the role is open to candidates across India, we prefer candidates currently based in
 **Delhi NCR** 
 .

description:
**Role:** 
 Sales Development Representative (SDR)
 



**Function:** 
 Sales / Business Development
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, India (U.S. business hours)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 AI, Medical SaaS, Dental
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company builds medical AI SaaS for the U.S. dental market.
 



 Its all\-in\-one platform unifies analytics, scheduling, communications, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of dental practices rely on it daily to grow revenue and improve patient experience.
 



 It integrates directly with leading practice\-management systems including Dentrix, Eaglesoft, and Open Dental. Founded in 2015 by a practicing dentist, a data strategist, and a PhD technologist.
 



 The team is mission\-driven, execution\-heavy, and moves fast with real, measurable impact.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 This is a founding SDR seat on a brand\-new pod of 4–5 reps, reporting directly to the Senior SDR Manager. You will own a defined book of dental practices, run high\-volume multi\-channel outbound, and book qualified demos for Account Executives—directly fueling the company's growth pipeline. The role operates on U.S. business hours from Gurugram and offers a clear path to Senior SDR or AE as the team scales.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Run 60–80 daily dials plus 40–50 emails and 10–15 social touches (Facebook/LinkedIn) targeting decision\-makers at dental practices
* Qualify prospects against the company's ICP and book 12–15 demos per month on AE calendars, targeting 8–10 held demos monthly
* Own a defined segment or practice\-management platform book; coordinate with teammates to prevent double\-touching prospects
* Log every call and outreach touchpoint in HubSpot the same day — 100% same\-day CRM hygiene is non\-negotiable
* Hand off qualified demos to AEs with full context — practice profile, pain points, and qualification notes — to maximize close rates
* Join the daily standup and protect structured power\-calling blocks throughout the U.S. shift
* Iterate on outbound messaging and sequencing based on coaching feedback and connect\-rate data



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 2\+ years of B2B cold\-calling or SaaS SDR experience with demonstrated high\-volume outbound (phone\-first)
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding demo\-booking or pipeline\-generation quotas
* Hands\-on CRM discipline — consistent same\-day logging with zero gaps in activity records
* Comfortable working U.S. business hours (EST/CST/PST) from Gurugram full\-time
* Articulate phone presence with the resilience to sustain 60–80 dials per day without drop\-off in quality
* Coachable — documented history of applying feedback quickly and improving metrics within a ramp period



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior exposure to dental, healthcare, or practice\-management software (Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental)
* HubSpot experience — sequences, task queues, and activity logging
* Multi\-channel outbound experience including LinkedIn Sales Navigator or Facebook outreach
* Experience in a founding or early\-stage SDR team where playbooks were still being built



  





**What We Offer** 



* Founding\-team seat with direct visibility to senior leadership and real ownership of pipeline outcomes
* Base salary plus uncapped variable compensation tied to qualified demos held — not just booked

 .

 Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
  

 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Manger” for driving the sales strategy and achieving business goals within your designated region, for executing the product management team's strategies, gathering customer feedback, and providing crucial insights for the development of new products. Your key focus will be on establishing and nurturing relationships with key opinion leaders, monitoring competitor information, and understanding prescription trends within the pharmaceutical industry. Additionally, you will be responsible for organizing and managing Continuing Medical Education (CME) events and other initiatives to bolster the company's brand image.
   

  

  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
  

 • You will be responsible for the promotion of the new product. You will be executing the Product Management Team’s marketing strategy, analysing market trends, consulting with doctors on new product potential, and relaying feedback to the Product Management Team. Additionally, responsibilities include identifying key opinion leaders, monitoring product availability, and implementing brand strategies to facilitate a successful product launch.
   

  

 • You will be responsible for monitoring primary and secondary sales through regular visits to stockists and pharmacies, ensuring the accomplishment of doctor and product\-specific sales objectives. Active participation in monthly review meetings to assess coverage, adherence to SOPs, and expense management, all aimed at achieving area\-level, product\-level, and overall sales targets.
   

  

 • You will be responsible for focusing on customer relationship management, the role entails establishing strong connections and addressing queries promptly using Infoginip. It also involves customer classification based on potential, determining meeting frequency accordingly, and tracking return on investment per customer to foster a loyal customer base for the company.
   

  

 • You will responsible to meet Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Key business leader (KEL) frequently and pursue them to conduct CME with the company; Collect interest areas of key customers and hospitals and conduct CMEs on those topics.
   

  

 • You will responsible to prepare product matrix depending upon doctor's potential \& preference and decide which product will fit doctor's need. Update data on chemist, doctors and Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) through palm top to Unnati portal in order to ensure all stakeholders' access to latest information.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Educational qualification\-** 
 Graduate with science background.
   

  

  

  

**Minimum work experience\-** 
 6 months of experience in pharmaceutical sales.
   

  

  

  

**Skills \& attributes
   

  

 Technical Skills**
  

 • Basic understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing
   

  

 • Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
   

  

 • Basic knowledge of Computers.
   

  

  

  

**Behavioural Skills**
  

 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 • Good at building and leveraging relationship.
   

  

 • Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
   

  

 • Strong Decision making skills.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**About the Department
   

  

 Global Generics India**
  

 Global Generics India business journey began in 1986\. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022\). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast\-growing organisation with double\-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti\-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.
   

  

  

  

**Benefits Offered**
  

 At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
   

  

 The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
   

  

  

  

**Our Work Culture**
  

 Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

description:
**Inside Sales Specialist \|\| Altera Institute \- Digiaccel Learning** 




  





 At Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute, we are on a mission to build the next generation of business leaders equipped for a digital and AI\-first world. Today, we are known in the industry for our deep education expertise in domains such as eCommerce, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Product \& AI. As a Program Expert in the Learner Success team, you will play a pivotal role in helping aspiring professionals make informed career decisions and unlock transformative learning opportunities.
 



  





 This is a learner\-centric role that goes beyond admissions and enrolments. You will serve as a trusted advisor and the first point of contact for prospective learners, understanding their career aspirations, professional challenges, and growth objectives. By guiding them towards the most suitable programs, you will help shape their educational journey and contribute directly to their long term career success.
 



  





 You will work closely with cross\-functional teams including Marketing, Product, Admissions, Career Services, and Academic Operations to ensure a seamless learner experience \- from the first interaction through onboarding and beyond. The ideal candidate is passionate about education, possesses strong interpersonal skills, and is motivated by creating meaningful impact in learners' lives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Learner Counselling \& Career Guidance** 



* Engage with prospective learners through calls, virtual meetings, emails, and other communication channels to understand their professional aspirations, learning needs, and career goals.
* Provide personalized guidance on Digiaccel and Altera programs, helping learners identify the most relevant learning pathways based on their background and objectives.
* Act as a trusted advisor throughout the decision\-making process, addressing queries and enabling learners to make informed educational investments.
* Build strong relationships with prospective learners by delivering a consultative and empathetic counselling experience.



**Admissions \& Onboarding Support** 



* Guide applicants through the admissions and enrolment journey, ensuring a smooth and positive onboarding experience.
* Support learners with application processes, documentation requirements, program information, and enrolment formalities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely communication and efficient resolution of learner concerns.
* Ensure every learner interaction reflects the organization’s commitment to quality, transparency, and learner success.



**Build vertical industry depth** 



* Build expertise of the Business education landscape, both at a postgraduate as well as executive level
* Identify advantages and disadvantages of different business education models and build conversational depth in how each model compares against the others.



**Learner Engagement \& Relationship Management** 



* Serve as a brand ambassador for Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute by effectively communicating the value proposition, program outcomes, and career impact of our offerings.
* Maintain consistent engagement with prospective learners through follow\-ups and personalized communication.
* Foster long\-term relationships that enhance learner trust, satisfaction, and advocacy.
* Capture learner feedback and insights to continuously improve the learner experience.



**Collaboration \& Process Excellence** 



* Work closely with Marketing, Product, Communications, and Academic teams to improve learner outreach, engagement, and conversion strategies.
* Maintain accurate learner records, pipeline updates, and interaction history through CRM systems and internal tools.
* Analyze learner feedback, market trends, and admission insights to contribute towards process improvements and operational excellence.
* Support organizational initiatives focused on enhancing learner outcomes and overall program experience.



**Performance \& Outcome Ownership** 



* Contribute towards enrolment and learner acquisition goals while maintaining a strong focus on ethics, learner satisfaction, and long\-term outcomes.
* Take ownership of individual performance metrics and continuously seek opportunities to improve effectiveness and impact.
* Demonstrate a learner\-first mindset in all interactions and decisions.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 1\-3\+ years of experience in learner counselling, admissions, sales, customer success, education, consulting, or other customer\-facing roles.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage and influence diverse audiences.
* A consultative and empathetic approach to understanding learner needs and guiding career decisions.
* Excellent relationship\-building and stakeholder management abilities.
* Strong ownership mindset with a results\-oriented approach.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and dynamic environment.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, Microsoft Office, and digital communication platforms.
* Passion for education, career transformation, and learner success.
* A collaborative team player with a growth mindset and strong problem\-solving skills.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* **Make a Meaningful Impact:** 
 Be part of an organization that is redefining business education and helping professionals build future\-ready careers in the digital economy.
* **High\-Growth Learning Environment:** 
 Work with a fast\-scaling education company where ownership, innovation and excellence are valued and rewarded.
* **Learner\-Centric Culture:** 
 Join a team that places learner outcomes at the center of every decision and takes pride in delivering world\-class educational experiences.
* **Accelerated Career Growth** 
 Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, mentorship, structured development, and the ability to take on increasing responsibility as the organization grows.
* **Build the Future of Education:** 
 Contribute to a mission\-driven organization that is transforming how business education is delivered and creating measurable impact for thousands of learners across the country.



  





**About the Company** 




 Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.
 



  





 Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher\-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.
 



  





 This is exactly what we solve for at Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute.
 



 The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%\+ NPS across all programs since inception.
 



  





 Digiaccel Learning is VC backed and has CXOs and Founders of some of India’s top digital commerce companies as it’s investors.
 



  





 We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment.
 



  





 We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

You will sell across AIONOS's full service line (Strategy, Consulting, Technology, Data and AI, Cloud, SAP, Security).

* Own revenue for a named account list. Build qualified pipeline and grow wallet share.
* Carry and deliver the number. An inside sales team supports the top of the funnel, but target attainment sits with you. You set account priorities, brief the inside sales executives, and source your own meetings wherever coverage falls short.
* Run pursuit and capture for large deals spanning multiple service lines, from qualification through commercial negotiation and closure.
* Split time between account research and GCC mapping in India, and US travel for meetings with decision makers and CXOs.
* Build account maps linking GCCs to their parent companies to find warm entry points into named accounts.
* Act as trusted advisor to GCC leadership on setup, expansion, and transformation.
* Represent AIONOS at GCC forums, industry events, and client roundtables. Feed market and competitive intelligence back into growth strategy.
* Work across Client Groups, Industry teams, and Global Sales on integrated account strategies.


**Experience**
**Must Have Skills**
* 7 to 10 years of enterprise technology consulting or sales experience, selling Digital, Cloud, Data and AI, or large transformation programmes into Travel, Transport, Logistics and Telecom clients.
* A live rolodex inside existing GCCs in these verticals. You should be able to open doors in weeks, not quarters.
* Track record running deals from start to finish, covering account mining, pipeline creation, CXO relationships, and commercial negotiation.


**Hunting and demand generation**
* Hardcore outbound experience selling to US and India enterprise buyers, including cold outreach, and meetings you sourced yourself. You should be able to walk us through your own prospecting method and how many connects turned into meetings.
* Able to direct inside sales effort well, with sharp targeting, clear messaging, and tight follow up, while still willing to pick up the phone yourself.
* Consistent record of carrying and hitting a quota, with numbers you can evidence. Bring the target, the achievement, the percentage, and the period for at least your last two or three cycles. We will ask.


**Thinking and initiative**
* Finds ways into accounts that others miss, and builds an offer around the client's real problem instead of a standard service pitch.
* Reads account data, org charts, and market signals to decide where to spend time, then tells a story good enough to get a meeting.
* Works without being managed. Brings ideas to leadership instead of waiting to be handed work. A strong r sum alone is not enough. We are screening for initiative and follow through, not credentials.


**Travel**
* Willing to travel to the US extensively, roughly half the year, on a cycle of 15 days in India followed by 15 days in the US. Valid passport required. US visa preferred.


**Good to Have**
* Exposure to GCC accounts and understanding of GCC operating models.
* Experience in GCC transformation programmes.
* Background at a Tier 1 consulting or systems integration firm.
* Existing relationships with NASSCOM chapter heads or the GCC Council are a definite plus.
* Experience managing strategic global accounts and complex pursuits with many stakeholders.
* Sales certification covering the full sales motion from prospecting to closing. Salesforce Certified Agentforce Sales Foundations is preferred. Equivalent certifications from HubSpot Academy or LinkedIn Learning are also relevant.


**Education**
 Bachelor's degree required. MBA or PGDM from a premier institute preferred.

 Company: Sphere Travel Media \& Exhibitions Pvt. Ltd.
 



 Position: Sales Executive – Exhibition Sales
 



 Experience: 1–2 Years
 



 Location: Chhatarpur, Delhi
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an enthusiastic and results\-driven Sales Executive to join our Exhibition Sales team. The candidate will be responsible for generating business, acquiring exhibitors and sponsors, building client relationships, and achieving sales targets for our exhibitions and events.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Identify and generate new business opportunities for exhibition space and sponsorship sales.
* Contact potential exhibitors, companies, tourism boards, and other relevant organizations through calls, emails, and meetings.
* Promote exhibition participation, sponsorship opportunities, and other event\-related services.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute towards the overall revenue of exhibitions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with prospects and maintain an updated sales pipeline.
* Prepare and share quotations, proposals, and other sales\-related documents with clients.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and participation of exhibitors.
* Attend client meetings, exhibitions, trade shows, and industry events as required.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, client interactions, and sales activities.
* Provide regular updates and reports to the reporting manager.



  





**Desired Skills \& Requirements** 



* **1–2 years of experience in Sales, Business Development, Event Sales, Exhibition Sales, or related fields.**
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong ability to generate leads and convert prospects into clients.
* Target\-oriented with a proactive and result\-driven approach.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and exhibitions, if required.
* Experience in exhibition, event, media, travel, tourism, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

title: Senior Account Executive - Public Sector
description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 The Program Lead’s primary responsibilities will include prospecting, qualifying, selling, and closing new business from existing and net new Power Utilities customers / State government customers. The Expert Program Lead will be responsible to bring a Point of View to the Customer engagement; uses all resources to solve customer problems with appropriate SAP Solutions. Account and Customer Relationship Management, Sales and Software License and Cloud Subscription Revenue.
   

  

* Annual Revenue \- Achieve / exceed quota targets.
* Sales strategies\- Align SAP Cloud /SaaS solutions with the customer's strategic objectives \- Develops best practice account plans to ensure revenue target delivery and sustainable growth. Develop relationships in new and existing customers and leverage to drive complex strategy through complex and global organizations.
* Trusted advisor \- Establishes strong management and Cxx relationships based on knowledge of customer requirements and commitment to value (value of counsel and expertise, value of solutions, value of implementation expertise). Builds a foundation on which to harvest future business opportunities and accurate account information and coaching.
* Customer Acumen \- Actively understand each customer's technology footprint, strategic growth plans, technology strategy and competitive landscape. Review public information (e.g. new executive appointments, earnings statements, press releases) for the company and its competitors to remain updated on key industry trends and issues impacting the prospect.
* Territory and Account Leadership \- Lead designated territory, including accounts, account relationships, prospect profiling, and sales cycles. Encourage all accounts to become SAP references.
* Business Planning \- Develop and deliver comprehensive business plan to address customer and prospects priorities and pain points. Utilize VE, benchmarking and ROI data to support the customer's decision process.


 Demand Generation, Pipeline and Opportunity Management
   

  

* Pipeline planning \- Follow a disciplined approach to maintaining a rolling pipeline. Keep pipeline current and moving up the pipeline curve.
* Pipeline partnerships \- Leverage support organizations including Marketing, Inside sales, Partners and channels to funnel pipeline into the assigned territory.
* Leverage SAP Solutions \- Be proficient in and bring all SAP offers to bear on sales pursuits including Industry Solutions, LOB solutions (CRM, SCM, HCM, SRM et. al) and technology solutions (Business Analytics, Mobility, Database and Technology, et. al). Demonstrate early adoption of all new solutions and strategies.
* Advance and close sales opportunities \- through the successful execution of the sales strategy and roadmap. Negotiate early and against a win/win strategy for SAP and its customers.
* Support all SAP promotions and events in the territory \- take an active, sales leadership role in SAP events.


 Sales Excellence
   

  

* Build and share best practice sales and negotiation skills.
* Sell value.
* Maintain White Space analysis and execution of initiatives (up sell and cross sell) on customer base.
* Orchestrate resources: deploy appropriate teams to execute winning sales. Create OneSAP.
* Utilize best practice sales models.
* Understand SAP's competition and effectively position solutions against them.
* Maintain CRM system with accurate customer and pipeline information.


 Leading a (Virtual) Account Team
   

  

* Mentor Associate /Senior Account Executives.
* Demonstrate leadership skills in the orchestration of remote teams.
* Ensure account teams and Partners are well versed in each account's strategy and well positioned for all customer touch points and events. Maximize the value of all sales support organizations.


**What You Bring**
* 15\+ years of experience in sales of complex business software / IT solutions
* Proven track record in business application software sales.
* Experience in lead role of a team selling environment.
* Demonstrated success with large transactions and lengthy sales campaigns in a fast\-paced, consultative and competitive market.
* Exceptional contractual and negotiation skills.
* Business level English: Fluent
* Local language: Fluent, Business Level
* Education: Bachelor equivalent: yes


**Bring out your best**
 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\-driven and future\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
   

  

**We win with inclusion**
 SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
   

  

 SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e\-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
   

  

 For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.
   

  

 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.
   

  

 Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.
   

  

**AI Usage in the Recruitment Process**
 For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.
   

  

 Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

title: Medical Sales Representative
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ripple Healthcare is dedicated to preventing hip fractures among older adults by eliminating the traditional tradeoff between mobility and safety. The company focuses on designing innovative, wearable fall\-protection solutions that are comfortable, unobtrusive, and suitable for everyday use.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Medical Sales Representative role based in Gurugram. The Medical Sales Representative will promote and sell Ripple Healthcare’s fall\-protection products to hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and other healthcare providers.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong Medical Sales skills with experience in selling healthcare devices or solutions to hospitals, clinics, or pharmacies.
* Excellent Communication and Customer Service abilities to build trust, educate stakeholders, and address inquiries or concerns professionally.
* Foundational knowledge of Medicine and Pharmacy domains to understand clinical workflows, patient needs, and product use in real\-world settings.
* Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets, manage a territory, and use CRM or sales reporting tools effectively.
* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, biomedical engineering, business, or a related field preferred.
* Comfort presenting to groups, conducting product demonstrations, and engaging with senior medical professionals.
* Strong organizational skills, reliability in follow\-up, and the ability to work independently in an on\-site, field\-oriented role.
* Prior experience in orthopedics, geriatrics, or medical devices is an advantage.

title: Business Development Manager — Agency Sales
description:
**Company:** 
 Looply
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



**CTC:** 
 ₹5–6 LPA, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated sales performance
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



 Candidates must currently be based in Delhi NCR. Please apply only if the stated compensation range aligns with your expectations.
 


 About Looply
 
 Looply is an AI\-native creative technology company that connects branding, websites, technology, marketing and automation into integrated growth systems.
 



 We work with ambitious businesses that want strategic thinking, strong creative execution and dependable technology under one roof.
 


 About the Role
 
 This is more than a lead\-generation or cold\-calling position.
 



 You will work closely with the founder to identify suitable markets and accounts, create qualified business opportunities, manage the sales pipeline and convert prospects into long\-term clients.
 



 You should be comfortable handling the sales journey from research and personalised outreach to discovery, solution\-building, proposals, negotiation and closure.
 


 What You Will DoBusiness Development
 * Identify potential clients across Looply’s branding, website, technology, marketing and automation services
* Build a qualified pipeline through outbound outreach, referrals, partnerships, networking and inbound opportunities
* Research target companies, industries and relevant decision\-makers
* Connect with founders, marketing heads, business heads and other senior stakeholders
* Execute personalised outreach through LinkedIn, email, calls and relevant channels
* Qualify opportunities based on business need, budget, authority, urgency and strategic fit
* Conduct discovery calls to understand client challenges, goals and buying requirements
* Coordinate with Looply’s strategy, creative and technology teams to shape suitable solutions
* Prepare proposals, pitch decks, scopes and commercial recommendations
* Manage follow\-ups, objections, negotiations and closures
* Maintain accurate pipeline information, communication history and next actions in the CRM


 Go\-to\-Market Execution
 * Work closely with the founder to refine ideal customer profiles, priority industries and target accounts
* Research competitors, buying behaviour and emerging client requirements
* Develop industry\-specific outreach angles and entry strategies
* Translate Looply’s capabilities into commercially relevant solutions
* Test and improve outreach messages, offers and sales approaches
* Help establish a repeatable and measurable business\-development process


 Revenue Growth
 * Build a healthy mix of project\-based engagements and recurring retainers
* Improve lead\-to\-meeting, meeting\-to\-proposal and proposal\-to\-close conversion rates
* Identify cross\-selling and upselling opportunities within existing accounts
* Develop relationships that generate repeat business and referrals
* Track pipeline value, sales cycle, conversion rates, win rate and revenue forecasts
* Contribute directly to Looply’s next stage of growth


 Sales Operations
 * Follow and improve the sales process from prospecting through closure and handover
* Create outreach sequences, qualification frameworks and follow\-up systems
* Maintain account intelligence, sales documentation and clear next actions
* Coordinate smooth handovers to account management and delivery teams
* Share market feedback that can improve Looply’s services, positioning and pricing


 What We Are Looking For
 * 3–5 years of relevant experience in business development, B2B sales, agency sales or digital\-services sales
* Demonstrable experience generating qualified opportunities and closing business
* Experience managing the complete sales cycle
* Strong understanding of consultative and solution\-based selling
* Ability to communicate confidently with founders and senior decision\-makers
* Strong research, outreach, discovery, presentation and negotiation skills
* Understanding of branding, digital marketing, websites, technology, software or automation services
* Commercial thinking with strong ownership and consistent follow\-through
* Comfort working in a growing company where processes are continuously being built and improved
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Current residence in Delhi NCR



 Experience selling services for a
 **creative, digital, marketing, technology, software or consulting company** 
 will be a strong advantage.
 


 This Role Is for You If
 * You enjoy building a sales pipeline instead of merely working through a contact list
* You can open conversations and move suitable opportunities towards closure
* You understand the difference between a lead and a commercially qualified opportunity
* You research companies before reaching out and personalise your communication
* You can connect client challenges with the right combination of Looply’s services
* You are comfortable taking ownership of targets, follow\-ups and outcomes
* You want to play a meaningful role in building a company’s next stage of growth


 To Apply
 
 Please share the following information:
 


* Companies, services or solutions you have previously sold
* Industries and decision\-makers you have sold to
* Your average deal size and typical sales cycle
* Revenue or qualified pipeline generated in your previous role
* One example of a client you acquired from first contact through closure
* One example of an outbound, GTM or partnership strategy you executed
* CRM and sales tools you have used
* Current location in Delhi NCR
* Current compensation
* Expected compensation
* Notice period



 Candidates with more than five years of experience may apply if the stated
 **₹5–6 LPA CTC range** 
 aligns with their expectations.
 



**Application subject line:** 




**Application — Business Development Manager, Agency Sales \| Looply**

title: Sales Trainee (Travel)
description:
**About WanderOn** 




 Remember the days when we used to fill our slam\-books with career aspirations like scientist, teacher and doctor? Nobody at that time thought there could’ve been a career in Traveling, let alone being a travelpreneur! But as life happens, you understand that a career could be anything where you can be a problem\-solver for society. And that’s how a few engineers from NIT Kurukshetra found that the travel industry in India needed a fresh burst of young energy! The need of the hour was to convert a dispersed agent\-based model to a more friendly, transparent and an accessible community for Indian travelers, and hence WanderOn. We at WanderOn are a modern travel community that provides end to end travel packages in India and abroad. We design the best travel itineraries that encourage group traveling for like\-minded people. Our services include road trips, trekking expeditions, corporate trips, and customized tour packages. On our trips, we ensure hassle\-free traveling, top\-notch accommodation and guided sightseeing that too on a budget.
 



  





**Position: Management Trainee\-Sales** 




 We are looking for a travel consultant to join our company to help us create and organize trips for our clients. You will be required to interact with our clients and guide them toward picking the best holiday package to suit all of their requirements. Your contribution will impact our company as well as the satisfaction of our customers and drive profits.
 



**Job Roles and Responsibilities:** 




 ● Help clients identify their ideal travel package and suggest the best package.
 



 ● Study and assimilate all information regarding travel destinations such as prices, weather, language, currency, customs, etc.
 



 ● Regularly maintain a good relationship with our customers.
 



 ● Sell the appropriate tour package to the right customer.
 



 ● Negotiate any customizations or modifications requested and accommodate to the best level possible.
 



 ● Reach the sales and revenue targets.
 



 ● Stay up to date on travel trends.
 



**Skills \& Qualifications Required:** 




 ● Excellent communication and people skills.
 



 ● Excellent negotiation and liaison skills.
 



 ● Natural rapport\-building skills.
 



 ● Strong customer service ethic.
 



 ● Self motivated and target driven.
 



 ● Critical thinker and problem solver
 



  





**Work location: Jaipur/Gurugram**

title: Vice President - Sales (Cloud)
description:
**Vice President — Sales (Cloud), India** 




  





  





**Title:** 
 Vice President — Sales, Cloud (India)
 



**Location:** 
 India — Delhi NCR / Mumbai / Bengaluru, with national travel
 



**Reports to:** 
 Founder / CEO
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time, individual contributor with a mandate to build a team from year two
 



**Function:** 
 New business origination — hunting, not account management
 



  





  





**What you will own** 




  





**Origination.:** 
 Build a named\-account plan for India and open those accounts yourself — cold, through
 



  your network, through partners, through tenders. Pipeline creation is the job, not a phase of it.
 



**Large deals from scratch.** 
 Take a first conversation to a signed multi\-crore, multi\-year contract.
 



  Shape the requirement before the RFP is written; where an RFP already exists, influence its terms.
 



**Executive access.** 
 Sell at CIO / CTO / Head of Infrastructure / CFO level, and hold your own in
 



  the room with their architects.
 



**Commercial construction.** 
 Build the commercial model with us — pricing, consumption terms, SLAs,
 



  payment milestones, exit clauses. You are expected to have a view, not to forward a rate card.
 



**The bid machine** 
 . Own qualification, bid/no\-bid discipline and win strategy across tenders,
 



  GeM bids and enterprise RFPs. Say no early and loudly to the ones we cannot win.
 



**Partner\-led reach.** 
 Recruit and activate system integrators, OEMs and channel partners where they
 



  shorten the path to a deal — and know when a partner is a route to market versus a layer of margin.
 



**Market feedback** 
 . Bring the market back into the product. What we lost on, and why, is as valuable
 



  to us as what you closed.
 



  





  





  





**Deal profile you will work** 




  





**Target segments:** 
 Enterprises, BFSI, telcos, data\-centre and hosting operators, PSUs and government, large SIs
 



**Typical deal size:** 
 ₹3–50 Cr TCV, multi\-year
 



**Sales cycle:** 
 6–18 months, multi\-stakeholder, technical evaluation plus procurement
 



**Buying motions** 
 : Direct enterprise, tender/GeM, partner\-led, OEM co\-sell
 



**What is being sold:** 
 Cloud platform, sovereign and private cloud builds, storage, AI/GPU infrastructure, managed services
 



  





**Who we are looking for** 




  





 \- 12\+ years in enterprise technology sales in India, with a substantial part in cloud, data centre,
 



  virtualisation, storage or infrastructure software.
 



 \- Demonstrable record of self\-originated deals above ₹5 Cr — you can name the account, describe
 



  how the first meeting happened, and explain how it closed.
 



 \- Comfortable selling infrastructure to technical buyers. You do not need to be an engineer, but you
 



  must be able to hold a conversation about compute, storage, networking, availability and migration
 



  without reaching for a specialist.
 



 \- An active, current network of CXO relationships in Indian enterprises or government.
 



 \- Experience with Indian public\-sector procurement — tenders, GeM, EMD, technical qualification criteria.
 



 \- Startup or challenger\-brand tolerance. You will sell against brands the buyer already knows, and you
 



  will sometimes be the reason they take the meeting.
 



  





**Strong signals** 




  





 \- Built a territory or a business line from zero.
 



 \- Sold both a platform and a managed service, and understands why the second changes the conversation.
 



 \- Existing relationships with SIs, DC operators or telcos in India.
 



 \- Has lost large deals and can talk about them honestly.
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 \- Fixed plus variable, weighted toward variable, uncapped on overachievement.
 



 \- Accelerators above target, and a bonus on the first two logos regardless of size.
 



 \- ESOP for the right candidate.
 



 \- Specific range discussed in the first conversation and set against experience and the plan you bring.

title: Media Sales Manager
description:
**ABOUT ADGRID** 




 AdGrid is an early\-stage, stealth\-mode AdTech–FinTech company based in Gurugram, building a platform at the intersection of advertising technology and financial infrastructure. We are a small, fast\-moving team hiring the people who will help shape the company from the ground up.
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




 This is a Media\-sales hire. You will own the demand side end\-to\-end, sign the first wave of media agencies and brands, turn the device's inventory into revenue, and build the commercial engine that scales AdGrid's advertising business. You sell the inventory to agencies, and you go direct to brands to win budgets and campaigns; the top line on the advertising side is yours to build.
 



  





 You sit at the intersection of online and offline advertising, so you bring real fluency in how the modern ad ecosystem works — brand and performance marketing, programmatic, and how major ad platforms work and you can translate that into a sharp story for a media buyer, a planner or a brand's marketing team. You are a hunter and a relationship\-builder in equal measure, comfortable opening and retaining relationships across media agencies, creative and marketing agencies, and brands directly. For a senior seller with a strong network, this is a rare chance to build something from the ground up and grow into a leadership seat.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Open net\-new business across media agencies, agency trading desks, media planners, creative and marketing agencies, and brands directly.
* Build a strong pipeline across high\-spend verticals — FMCG, BFSI, auto, e\-commerce, telecom, D2C and more.
* A strong, active network across media agencies, creative / marketing agencies and brand marketers, and a track record of turning those relationships into net\-new wins.
